translations.source: “Yanzu muna bera mai watanni 4 wadanda ba su da ciwon sukari ba wadanda ke da suke fama da ciwon sukari,” in ji shi.
translations.reference: "We now have 4-month-old mice that are non-diabetic that used to be diabetic," he added.
translations.hypothesis: "We are currently conducting a 4-month trial involving individuals who do not have diabetes, as well as those who are living with the condition."

translations.source: Dokta Ehud Ur, farfesan magani a Jami’ar Dalhousie da ke Halifax, Nova Scotia kuma shugaban sashen likitanci da bangaren kimiyya na kungiyar masu ciwon sikari ta Kanada ya yi gargadin cewa har yanzu binciken yana kan farkonsa.
translations.reference: Dr. Ehud Ur, professor of medicine at Dalhousie University in Halifax, Nova Scotia and chair of the clinical and scientific division of the Canadian Diabetes Association cautioned that the research is still in its early days.
translations.hypothesis: Dr. Ehud Ur, a professor of medicine at Dalhousie University in Halifax, Nova Scotia, and the head of the medical and scientific division of Diabetes Canada, has cautioned that the research is still in its early stages.

translations.source: Kamar wasu ƙwararrun, yana da shakkun cewa ko za a iya warkar da ciwon sukari, inda ya bayyana cewa sakamakon bincike ba shi da alaƙa da mutanen da tuni su ke da nau’in ciwon sukari na 1.
translations.reference: Like some other experts, he is skeptical about whether diabetes can be cured, noting that these findings have no relevance to people who already have Type 1 diabetes.
translations.hypothesis: Like some experts, he is skeptical about the possibility of curing diabetes, and he pointed out that the research findings do not apply to people who already have type 1 diabetes.

translations.source: A ranar Litinin, Sara Danius, sakatariyar dindindin ta Kwamitin Adabi na kungiyar nagartattu a Kwalejin Nazarin Sweden, ta sanar a bainar jama'a yayin wani shirin rediyo a Sveriges Radio a Sweden kwamitin, ba zai iya kaiwa ga Bob Dylan kai tsaye ba game da lashe kyautar Nobel ta 2016 a Adabi, ta yi watsi da ita kokarinta na isa gare shi.
translations.reference: On Monday, Sara Danius, permanent secretary of the Nobel Committee for Literature at the Swedish Academy, publicly announced during a radio program on Sveriges Radio in Sweden the committee, unable to reach Bob Dylan directly about winning the 2016 Nobel Prize in Literature, had abandoned its efforts to reach him.
translations.hypothesis: On Monday, Sara Danius, the permanent secretary of the Swedish Academy's Nobel Committee, publicly stated during a radio program on Sveriges Radio in Sweden that the committee could not directly contact Bob Dylan regarding the 2016 Nobel Prize in Literature, and that she had dismissed any attempts to reach him.

translations.source: Danius ya ce, “Yanzu haka ba mwa yin komi. Na kira na kuma aika emails zuwa abokan aikinsa na kusa na kuma anshi amsoshi masu kyau. A yanzu haka, wannan bai isa ba.”
translations.reference: Danius said, "Right now we are doing nothing. I have called and sent emails to his closest collaborator and received very friendly replies. For now, that is certainly enough."
translations.hypothesis: Danius said, "Right now, we're not doing anything. I've made calls and sent emails to my close colleagues, and I've received some positive responses. However, at this point, it's not enough."

translations.source: A baya, Shugaban kamfanin Ring, Jamie Siminoff, ya bayyana cewa kamfanin ya fara lokacin da ba a jiyo sauti kararrawar jikin ƙofar sa daga shagonsa a cikin garejinsa.
translations.reference: Previously, Ring's CEO, Jamie Siminoff, remarked the company started when his doorbell wasn't audible from his shop in his garage.
translations.hypothesis: Previously, the CEO of Ring, Jamie Siminoff, explained that the company was founded after he couldn't hear his garage door closing from inside his house.

translations.source: Ya ce, ya gina ƙararrawar ƙofa ta WiFi.
translations.reference: He built a WiFi door bell, he said.
translations.hypothesis: He said he built a Wi-Fi enabled door lock.

translations.source: Siminoff yace ciniki ya karu baya futuwar sa ta 2013 a shinrin wasan kwaikwayin Shark Tank inda masu shirin suka ki biyan kudin sabuwar sana'ar.
translations.reference: Siminoff said sales boosted after his 2013 appearance in a Shark Tank episode where the show panel declined funding the startup.
translations.hypothesis: Siminoff said the sales increase came after his appearance on the 2013 season of the Shark Tank, where the show's investors declined to invest in his new business.

translations.source: A ƙarshen 2017, Siminoff ya bayyana a tashar telebijin mai sayarwa ta QVC.
translations.reference: In late 2017, Siminoff appeared on shopping television channel QVC.
translations.hypothesis: At the end of 2017, Siminoff appeared on the QVC shopping channel.

translations.source: Ring ta kuma sasanta takardar kotu tsakanin wata kamfanin adawa na tsaro wato ADT Corporation.
translations.reference: Ring also settled a lawsuit with competing security company, the ADT Corporation.
translations.hypothesis: The ruling also involved a court document related to a dispute between a security company, ADT Corporation.

translations.source: Yayinda allurar gwaji rigakafi guda daya ta bayyana tana iya rage mutuwar cutar ta Ebola, har zuwa yanzu, babu wasu kwayoyi da aka nuna da suka dace da maganin cututtukan da suke kamuwa da su.
translations.reference: While one experimental vaccine appears able to reduce Ebola mortality, up until now, no drugs have been clearly demonstrated suitable for treating existing infection.
translations.hypothesis: While a single experimental vaccine has shown promise in reducing mortality from the Ebola virus, to date, there are no other drugs that have been proven effective in treating the diseases it causes.

translations.source: Wani hadaddiyar giyar, ZMapp, da farko ya nuna alƙawari a fagen, amma nazarin yau da kullun ya nuna cewa ba shi da fa'ida fiye da yadda ake neman hana mutuwa.
translations.reference: One antibody cocktail, ZMapp, initially showed promise in the field, but formal studies indicated it had less benefit than sought in preventing death.
translations.hypothesis: A promising drug, ZMapp, initially showed great potential in the field, but further research has indicated that its effectiveness in preventing death is not as significant as initially hoped.

translations.source: a nan gwajin PALM, ZMapp yayi bauta a wajen kula, hakan na nufin masana fasaha sun yi amfani da shi a matsayin kasan idan ka kimanta da hanyoyin guda uku nashi.
translations.reference: In the PALM trial, ZMapp served as a control, meaning scientists used it as a baseline and compared the three other treatments to it.
translations.hypothesis: Regarding the PALM and ZMapp tests, the former was used as a benchmark for comparison, meaning that experts used it as a standard when evaluating the other two methods.

translations.source: Masu wasan tsalle tsalle na Amurka sun goyi bayan wasikar kwamitin gasar olympic tare da yarda da cikakkiyar bukatar duk masu wasan olympic da su yada maganar samar da yanayi mara hadari ga dukkan yan wasanmu.
translations.reference: USA Gymnastics supports the United States Olympic Committee's letter and accepts the absolute need of the Olympic family to promote a safe environment for all of our athletes.
translations.hypothesis: American gymnasts have expressed their support for the Olympic committee's investigation, emphasizing the importance of ensuring a safe environment for all athletes. They believe that all Olympic participants should actively promote a culture of safety and well-being.

translations.source: Mun yarda da bayanin USOC cewa bukatun ƴan wasanmu da kungiyar mu, da wasanninsu, na iya zama mafi alheri ta ci gaba tare da canji mai ma'ana a cikin ƙungiyarmu, maimakon ƙaddamar da doka.
translations.reference: We agree with the USOC's statement that the interests of our athletes and clubs, and their sport, may be better served by moving forward with meaningful change within our organization, rather than decertification.
translations.hypothesis: We agree with the USOC's statement that the needs of our athletes and our organization, and their sports, may be better served by implementing meaningful changes within our organization, rather than by imposing a strict rule.

translations.source: Kungiyan daki motsa jiki na USA na goyon bayan bincike mai zaman kanta wadda take zaton zata kara haske kan cin zarafi wadda wadanda suka tsira daga Larry Nassar suka bayana wadda ba a gano ba na tsawon lokaci kuma ke rungume da duk wani canji mai muhimmanci.
translations.reference: USA Gymnastics supports an independent investigation that may shine light on how abuse of the proportion described so courageously by the survivors of Larry Nassar could have gone undetected for so long and embraces any necessary and appropriate changes.
translations.hypothesis: The U.S. Gymnastics governing body is supporting an independent investigation that aims to shed light on the abuse suffered by survivors of Larry Nassar, abuse that was previously unreported and which encompasses significant changes.

translations.source: Gidan motsa jiki na Amurka da USOC suna da manufa ɗaya - sa wasan motsa jiki, da sauransu, ya zama mai aminci yadda zai yiwu ƴan wasa su bi mafarkinsu cikin aminci, tabbatacce kuma mai ba da ƙarfi.
translations.reference: USA Gymnastics and the USOC have the same goal — making the sport of gymnastics, and others, as safe as possible for athletes to follow their dreams in a safe, positive and empowered environment.
translations.hypothesis: The United States Olympic & Paralympic Committee (USOPC) and the U.S. Anti-Doping Agency share a common goal: to make sports, and all related activities, as safe as possible, so that athletes can pursue their dreams in a safe, supportive, and empowering environment.

translations.source: A duk tsawon 1960, Brzezinski yayi ma John F. Kenedy aiki a matsayin mai bada shawara kuma yayi aiki da gwamnatin Lyndon B. Johnson.
translations.reference: Throughout 1960s, Brzezinski worked for John F. Kennedy as his advisor and then the Lyndon B. Johnson administration.
translations.hypothesis: Throughout the 1960s, Brzezinski served as an advisor to John F. Kennedy and worked with the administration of Lyndon B. Johnson.

translations.source: A yayin zabukan 1976 ya shawarci Carter kan manufofin kasashen waje, sannan ya zama mai ba da shawara kan Tsaro na kasa (NSA) daga 1977 zuwa 1981, ya gaji Henry Kissinger.
translations.reference: During the 1976 selections he advised Carter on foreign policy, then served as National Security Advisor (NSA) from 1977 to 1981, succeeding Henry Kissinger.
translations.hypothesis: During the 1976 elections, he advised Carter on foreign policy matters. He then served as National Security Advisor (NSA) from 1977 to 1981, succeeding Henry Kissinger.

translations.source: kasancewarsa dan NSA, ya taimaka wa Carter a harkokin dokokin kasashen waje wajen kula da lamuran duniya, kamar Yarjejeniyar Camp David, 1978; daidaita alaƙar Amurka da China tana tunanin ƙarshen shekarun 1970; juyin juya halin Iran, wanda ya haifar da rikicin garkuwar da Iran, 1979; da mamayar Soviet a Afghanistan, 1979.
translations.reference: As NSA, he assisted Carter in diplomatically handling world affairs, such as the Camp David Accords, 1978; normalizing US–China relations thought the late 1970s; the Iranian Revolution, which led to the Iran hostage crisis, 1979; and the Soviet invasion in Afghanistan, 1979.
translations.hypothesis: As National Security Advisor, he assisted President Carter in foreign policy matters, managing global affairs such as the Camp David Accords of 1978; the normalization of relations between the United States and China in the late 1970s; the Iranian Revolution, which led to the Iran hostage crisis in 1979; and the Soviet invasion of Afghanistan in 1979.

translations.source: Fin ɗin, da ke nuna Ryan Gosling da Emma Stone, ya sami shiga cikin duk manyan ɓangarorin gasar.
translations.reference: The movie, featuring Ryan Gosling and Emma Stone, received nominations in all major categories.
translations.hypothesis: The film, starring Ryan Gosling and Emma Stone, has been nominated in all major categories.

translations.source: Gosling da Stone sun sami shiga neman cikin kyautar Fitaccen Jarumi da Jaruma.
translations.reference: Gosling and Stone received nominations for Best Actor and Actress respectively.
translations.hypothesis: Gosling and Stone are both nominated for the award for Best Actor and Best Actress.

translations.source: Sauran zaɓin sun hada da Hoto Mafi Kyau, Darakta, Majigi, Tsara Tufafi, Gyaran fina-finai, Makin Asali, Tsara Shiri, Gyara Sauti, Haɗa Sauti da kuma Asalin Labari.
translations.reference: The other nominations include Best Picture, Director, Cinematography, Costume Design, Film-editing, Original Score, Production Design, Sound Editing, Sound Mixing and Original Screenplay.
translations.hypothesis: The other categories include: Best Picture, Director, Screenplay, Cinematography, Film Editing, Original Score, Production Design, Sound Design, and Original Story.

translations.source: Waƙoƙi biyu daga fim, Audition (Wawaye Waɗanda Suke Mafarki) da Birnin Taurari, sun karɓi zaɓi don mafi kyawun waƙar asali. Lionsgate studio ta sami nadin 26 - fiye da kowane sauran ɗakunan studio.
translations.reference: Two songs from the movie, Audition (The Fools Who Dream) and City of Stars, received nominations for best original song. Lionsgate studio received 26 nominations — more than any other studio.
translations.hypothesis: Two songs from the films "Audition (Dreams That Kill)" and "City of Stars" have been nominated for the Best Original Song award. Lionsgate studio received 26 nominations, more than any other studio.

translations.source: A daren ranar Lahadi shugaban kasar Amurka Donald Trump a cikin wata sanarwa da aka fitar ta sanarwar sakataren, ya sanar da dakarun kasar Amurka zasu bar kasar Syria.
translations.reference: Late on Sunday, the United States President Donald Trump, in a statement delivered via the press secretary, announced US troops would be leaving Syria.
translations.hypothesis: On Sunday evening, U.S. President Donald Trump announced, in a statement released by his press secretary, that U.S. troops would be withdrawing from Syria.

translations.source: An bayar da sanarwar ce bayan Trump ya yi ganawa ta wayar salula da Shugaban Turkiyya Recep Tayyip Erdogan.
translations.reference: The announcement was made after Trump had a phone conversation with Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan.
translations.hypothesis: The announcement was made after a phone call between former U.S. President Donald Trump and Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan.

translations.source: Haka kuma Turkiyya za ta karbi aikin gadin mayakan ISIS da aka kama waɗanda, sanarwar ta ce, kasashen Turai suka ki mayar da su.
translations.reference: Turkey would also take over guarding captured ISIS fighters which, the statement said, European nations have refused to repatriate.
translations.hypothesis: Furthermore, Turkey will accept the transfer of ISIS fighters who have been captured, according to the statement, and whom European countries have refused to take back.

translations.source: Wannan ya tabbatar cewa ba wai kawai wasu dabbobin dinasour suna da gashi ba, wata fadar ma da ta yadu, amma ta yi cikakken bayanin da rubabbun halittu ba za su iya ba, kamar su launi da kuma tsarin kashi uku.
translations.reference: This not only confirms that at least some dinosaurs had feathers, a theory already widespread, but provides details fossils generally cannot, such as color and three-dimensional arrangement.
translations.hypothesis: This confirms that not only did some dinosaur species have feathers, a widely accepted idea, but that these feathered creatures also possessed features that are difficult to represent in traditional depictions, such as color and complex patterns.

translations.source: Masana ilimin kimiya sun ce fiffiken dabbar launi kasa ne a sama mai dauke da kodaden launi da launin toka-toka ta karkashin ta.
translations.reference: . Scientists say this animal's plumage was chestnut-brown on top with a pale or carotenoid-colored underside.
translations.hypothesis: Scientists say that a rainbow is a multicolored arc that appears in the sky, formed by the refraction and reflection of sunlight through water droplets.

translations.source: Binciken ya kuma ba da haske game da juyin halittar fukafiki a tsuntsaye.
translations.reference: The find also grants insight into the evolution of feathers in birds.
translations.hypothesis: The study also shed light on the process of star formation in galaxies.

translations.source: Domin gashin fuka-fukin dinosaur bashi da isasshen tsari, wanda ake kira kara, amma suna da sauran sifofin gashin fuka-fukan — tsandar gashi da kananan — masu binciken sun kammala cewa wata kila karan wani cigaba ne na juyin halittan wadannan sauran sifofin.
translations.reference: Because the dinosaur feathers do not have a well-developed shaft, called a rachis, but do have other features of feathers — barbs and barbules — the researchers inferred the rachis was likely a later evolutionary development that these other features.
translations.hypothesis: While dinosaur feathers lacked the complex structure, known as barbs, that characterize modern feathers, they possessed other feather-like features – such as vanes and small filaments. Researchers have concluded that these other features may represent an earlier stage in the evolutionary development of feathers.

translations.source: Tsarin gashin fuka-fukan ya nuna cewa ba ana amfani da su ba ne domin tashi sama, sai dai domin samar da tsarin daidaiton dumin jiki da kuma motsawa. Binciken ya nuna cewa duk da cewa jelar ta wani karamin kakan kadangare ce, abin na nuna cewa gashin balagagge ne ba na dan tsako ba.
translations.reference: The feathers' structure suggests that they were not used in flight but rather for temperature regulation or display. The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
translations.hypothesis: The structure of the feathers indicates that they are not used for flight, but rather for maintaining a stable body temperature and facilitating movement. The research suggests that, despite being a small, nocturnal animal, the creature possesses mature feathers, indicating that it is not a juvenile.

translations.source: Masu binciken sun nuna cewa, duk da cewa sun gamsu jelar ta kakannin kadangare ce, ta kuma nuna cewa ta balagagge ce ba jariri ba.
translations.reference: The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
translations.hypothesis: Researchers have found that, while they initially believed the creature to be a juvenile, further examination revealed that it was actually a fully grown adult.

translations.source: Jiya da safe a ƙasar Turkiyya, wani bom na cikin mota da aka tayar a hedikwatar ‘yansanda da ke Gaziantep, ya yi sanadiyyar mutuwar jami’an ‘yan sanda biyu tare da raunata wasu mutane sama da ashirin.
translations.reference: A car bomb detonated at police headquarters in Gaziantep, Turkey yesterday morning killed two police officers and injured more than twenty other people.
translations.hypothesis: Yesterday morning in Turkey, a car bomb that exploded at a police headquarters in Gaziantep resulted in the deaths of two police officers and injuries to more than twenty other people.

translations.source: Ofishin gwamnan ya ce jamia’an yan sanda goma sha tara ne su ka sami raunuka.
translations.reference: The governor's office said nineteen of the injured were police officers.
translations.hypothesis: The governor's office stated that nineteen police officers were injured.

translations.source: Ƴan sanda sun ce suna zargin wani da ake zargin dan ta'addar Daesh (ISIL) ne da alhakin kai harin.
translations.reference: Police said they suspect an alleged Daesh (ISIL) militant of responsibility for the attack.
translations.hypothesis: Police say they suspect a man believed to be a member of the Daesh (ISIL) terrorist group is responsible for the attack.

translations.source: Sun gano cewa Rana na aiki akan manufa iri daya kamar sauran taurari: An gano cewa ayukkan duk taurari a cikin tsarin suna samuwa ne ta hasken su, juyin su, banda haka babu komai.
translations.reference: They found the Sun operated on the same basic principles as other stars: The activity of all stars in the system was found to be driven by their luminosity, their rotation, and nothing else.
translations.hypothesis: They discovered that the Sun operates on the same principles as other stars. It was found that the activities of all stars within the system are generated through their light and rotation; nothing else is involved.

translations.source: Ana amfani da haskawa da juyawa tare domin sanin lambar Rossby ta tauraro, wadda take da alaƙa da gudanar jini.
translations.reference: The luminosity and rotation are used together to determine a star's Rossby number, which is related to plasma flow.
translations.hypothesis: The Rossby number, which is related to blood flow, can be determined using a combination of illumination and rotation.

translations.source: Rashin karfin lambar Rossby daidai yake da rashin karfin tauraron tare da magnetic reversal
translations.reference: The smaller the Rossby number, the less active the star with respect to magnetic reversals.
translations.hypothesis: The weakening of the Rossby wave is correlated with the weakening of the stellar wind and magnetic reversals.

translations.source: A lokacin tafiyarsa, Iwasaki ya shiga cikin matsala a lokuta da yawa.
translations.reference: During his trip, Iwasaki ran into trouble on many occasions.
translations.hypothesis: During his travels, Iwasaki encountered numerous difficulties.

translations.source: Yan fashin teku sun yi masa fashi, mahaukacin kare ya kai masa farmaki a Tibet, ya guje wa aure a Nepal kuma an kama shi a India.
translations.reference: He was robbed by pirates, attacked in Tibet by a rabid dog, escaped marriage in Nepal and was arrested in India.
translations.hypothesis: He escaped from prison, was attacked by a powerful guard in Tibet, avoided marriage in Nepal, and was arrested in India.

translations.source: Kwatancin 802.11n na aiki duk akan mita 2.4Ghz da 5.0Ghz.
translations.reference: The 802.11n standard operates on both the 2.4Ghz and 5.0Ghz frequencies.
translations.hypothesis: The 802.11n standard operates on both the 2.4 GHz and 5.0 GHz frequency bands.

translations.source: Wannan zai ba shi damar zama mai dacewa da baya 802.11a, 802.11b da 802.11g, matukar dai tashar tushe tana da rediyo biyu.
translations.reference: This will allow it to be backwards compatible with 802.11a, 802.11b and 802.11g, provided that the base station has dual radios.
translations.hypothesis: This would allow it to be compatible with the 802.11a, 802.11b, and 802.11g standards, provided that the base station has two radios.

translations.source: Gudun 802.11n na da saurin da ya zarce na wanda ya gabace shi da tsaikon saurin da ya kai 600Mbit/s.
translations.reference: The speeds of 802.11n are substantially faster than that of its predecessors with a maximum theoretical throughput of 600Mbit/s.
translations.hypothesis: The 802.11n standard offers a speed that surpasses its predecessor, with a data transfer rate of up to 600 Mbit/s.

translations.source: Duvall, wanda ke da mata da manyan yaya guda biyu, bai burge Miller ba, wanda ke da alaƙa da labarin.
translations.reference: Duvall, who is married with two adult children, did not leave a big impression on Miller, to whom the story was related.
translations.hypothesis: Duvall, who has two wives and two grown sons, did not impress Miller, who is involved in the story.

translations.source: Da aka nemi tsokacinsa, sai Miller ya ce, “Mike ya yi magana da yawa lokacin zaman jin ba’asin...ina kan shiri saboda haka ban saurari abin da yake cewa ba.”
translations.reference: When asked for comment, Miller said, "Mike talks a lot during the hearing...I was getting ready so I wasn't really hearing what he was saying."
translations.hypothesis: When asked for his reaction, Miller said, "Mike spoke a lot during the meeting... I was prepared for that, so I didn't really pay attention to what he was saying."

translations.source: “Za mu kokarin rage fitar da gurbataccen carbon dioxide a kowane bangare na GDP ta wani muhimmin mataki a 2020 daga matakin 2005,” in ji Hu.
translations.reference: "We will endeavour to cut carbon dioxide emissions per unit of GDP by a notable margin by 2020 from the 2005 level," Hu said.
translations.hypothesis: "We will strive to reduce carbon dioxide emissions per unit of GDP by a significant margin in 2020, compared to the 2005 levels," said Hu.

translations.source: Bai sanya wani adadi don ragewar ba, inda ya ce hakan zai danganta ne da abin da tattalin arzikin China ke fitarwa.
translations.reference: He did not set a figure for the cuts, saying they will be made based on China's economic output.
translations.hypothesis: He did not specify any particular reduction target, stating that it would depend on the performance of the Chinese economy.

translations.source: Hu ya karfafa kasashe masu tasowa “da su guji tsohuwar hanyar gurbatar da farko da kuma tsabtace ta daga baya.”
translations.reference: Hu encouraged developing countries "to avoid the old path of polluting first and cleaning up later."
translations.hypothesis: He urged developing countries to avoid the "old path of polluting first and cleaning up later."

translations.source: Ya kara da cewa “ kada su yunkura, sai dai kuwa ana sa su daukar nauyi sama da na matakin cigaban su, da kuma daukan alhaki da iyawar su.”
translations.reference: He added that "they should not, however, be asked to take on obligations that go beyond their development stage, responsibility and capabilities."
translations.hypothesis: He added, "They should not be pressured, but rather given responsibilities that are appropriate for their level of development, and that align with their capabilities and potential."

translations.source: Kungiyar bincike na Iraq sun gabatar da rohotonsu da karfe 12.00 GMT a yau.
translations.reference: The Iraq Study Group presented its report at 12.00 GMT today.
translations.hypothesis: The Iraqi investigative committee presented its report at 12:00 GMT today.

translations.source: An yi kashedin cewa babu tabbacin cewa duk wani mataki da za’a dauka a kasar Iraki a yanzu zai iya maganin yakin banbance banbance darika, karuwar rikici ko ma dosar rashin doka da oda.
translations.reference: It warns No one can guarantee that any course of action in Iraq at this point will stop sectarian warfare, growing violence, or a slide toward chaos.
translations.hypothesis: There are concerns that any action taken in Iraq at this time may not resolve the sectarian conflict, escalating tensions, or the prevailing state of lawlessness.

translations.source: Rahoton ya buɗe ne tare da roƙo don buɗe muhawara da kuma kafa yarjejeniya a Amurka game da manufofin Gabas ta Tsakiya.
translations.reference: The Report opens with plea for open debate and the formation of a consensus in the United States about the policy towards the Middle East.
translations.hypothesis: The report began with a call for open dialogue and the establishment of a consensus in the United States regarding policies towards the Middle East.

translations.source: Rahoton ya yi matuƙar yin suka ga kusan dukkan ɓangarorin manufar Ɓangaren zartaswa na yanzu akan ƙasar Iraƙi inda ya nemi a gaggauta canja alƙibla.
translations.reference: The Report is highly critical of almost every aspect of the present policy of the Executive towards Iraq and it urges an immediate change of direction.
translations.hypothesis: The report strongly criticized nearly all aspects of the current executive policy regarding Iraq, urging for an immediate change of course.

translations.source: Na farko daga cikin shawarwarin da ta ba su guda 78 shi ne cewa ya kamata a dauki wani sabon shiri na diflomasiyya kafin karshen wannan shekarar don kiyaye iyakokin Iraki kan tsoma bakin da ake yi da kuma sake kulla alakar diflomasiyya da makwabtanta.
translations.reference: First among its 78 recommendations is that a new diplomatic initiative should be taken before the end of this year to secure Iraq’s borders against hostile interventions and to re-establish diplomatic relations with its neighbors.
translations.hypothesis: The first of the 78 recommendations she made was that a new diplomatic initiative should be launched before the end of this year to protect Iraq's borders from encroachment and to re-establish diplomatic relations with its neighbors.

translations.source: Majalisar dattijai da matar shugaban kasar Argentina Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner ta sanar da fitowar takarar shugaban kasa a yammacin jiya a La Plata, gari dake kilomita 50 (Mil 31) daga Buenos Aires.
translations.reference: Current senator and Argentine First Lady Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner announced her presidential candidacy yesterday evening in La Plata, a city 50 kilometers (31 miles) away from Buenos Aires.
translations.hypothesis: The Argentine Senate and First Lady Cristina Fernández de Kirchner announced her candidacy for president yesterday afternoon in La Plata, a city located 50 kilometers (31 miles) from Buenos Aires.

translations.source: Mrs. Kirchner ta bayyana ra’niyyarta ta tsayawa takarar shugabanci a Gidan wasannin Argentina, wurin da ta yi amfani da shi domin fara kanfen ɗinta na takarar Majalisar Dattawa a shekarar 2005 a matsayinta na wakiliyar Buenos Aires.
translations.reference: Mrs. Kirchner announced her intention to run for president at the Argentine Theatre, the same location she used to start her 2005 campaign for the Senate as member of the Buenos Aires province delegation.
translations.hypothesis: Mrs. Kirchner announced her presidential candidacy at a sports stadium in Argentina, the same venue where she launched her campaign for the Senate in 2005, representing the province of Buenos Aires.

translations.source: Muhawarar ta samo asali sakamakon rudani game da kashe kudi wajen bada tallafi da sake gine-gine bayan faruwar guguwar katrina, abinda masu ra’ayin mazan jiya su ke tsokana da cewa “Cuwa-cuwar Bush ta New Orleans”
translations.reference: The debate was sparked by controversy over spending on relief and reconstruction in the wake Hurricane Katrina; which some fiscal conservatives have humorously labeled "Bush's New Orleans Deal."
translations.hypothesis: The debate originated from disagreements about the allocation of funds for relief and reconstruction efforts following Hurricane Katrina, a situation that critics often referred to as the "Bush administration's mismanagement of New Orleans."

translations.source: Korafe-korafe kan yunƙurin sake gine-ginen ya maida hankali ne a kan bayar da kwangilolin sake ginin ga waɗanda ake ganin ‘yan cikin gida ne a Washington.
translations.reference: Liberal criticism of the reconstruction effort has focused on the awarding of reconstruction contracts to perceived Washington insiders.
translations.hypothesis: The controversy surrounding reconstruction efforts has focused on the awarding of reconstruction contracts to companies perceived to be based in Washington.

translations.source: Fiye da mutane miliyan huɗu suka je Rome don halartar jana’izar.
translations.reference: Over four million people went to Rome to attend the funeral.
translations.hypothesis: Over six million people traveled to Rome to attend the funeral.

translations.source: mutanen da suka halarta sun yi yawa yadda ba zai yiwu kowa ya iya samun shiga wajen jana’izar ba da ke dandalin Peter.
translations.reference: The number of people present was so large that it was not possible for everybody to gain access to the funeral in St. Peter's Square.
translations.hypothesis: The number of people who attended was so large that it was impossible for everyone to fit inside the Peter Square venue for the funeral.

translations.source: An kafa manya garkuwan talabijin da dama wurare da dama a Rome domin mutane su samu daman kallon bikin.
translations.reference: Several large television screens were installed in various places in Rome to let the people watch the ceremony.
translations.hypothesis: Large television screens have been set up in various locations in Rome so that people can watch the event.

translations.source: A sauran biranen kasar Italiya da kuma sauran kasashen duniya musamman a Poland, an kafa makamancin ginuwar wanda ya samu dubiyar jama’a da dama.
translations.reference: In many other cities of Italy and in the rest of the world, particularly in Poland, similar setups were made, which were viewed by a great number of people.
translations.hypothesis: Similar structures, attracting significant public attention, have also been built in other Italian cities and in other countries around the world, particularly in Poland.

translations.source: Masana tarihi sun soki manufofin Hukumar bincike ta Amurka saboda mai da hankali wajen laifuka wadanda ke da saukin warwarewa, musamman satar motoci, domin kawai su nuna yawan nasarar da su ke samu.
translations.reference: Historians have criticized past FBI policies for focusing resources on cases which are easy to solve, especially stolen car cases, with the intent of boosting the agency's success rate.
translations.hypothesis: Historians have criticized the policies of the U.S. investigative agency for focusing on crimes that are easily solved, particularly car thefts, simply to showcase their success rate.

translations.source: Majalisa ta fara samar da kuɗaɗe ga tsarin batsa a kasafin kudi na 2005 kuma ta fayyace cewa dole FBI ta ware jami’ai 10 don lura da hotunan batsa na manya.
translations.reference: Congress began funding the obscenity initiative in fiscal 2005 and specified that the FBI must devote 10 agents to adult pornography.
translations.hypothesis: The parliament began allocating funds for combating child pornography in the 2005 budget and stipulated that the FBI must assign 10 agents to monitor images of child sexual abuse.

translations.source: Robin Uthappa shine wanda yafi ciyowa innings kwallo, inda ya ciwo kwallo 41 a cikin 70 ta duka me hudu sau 11 da kuma me shiga sau 2.
translations.reference: Robin Uthappa made the innings highest score, 70 runs in just 41 balls by hitting 11 fours and 2 sixes.
translations.hypothesis: Robin Uthappa was the top scorer in the innings, scoring 41 runs off 70 balls, with 11 fours and 2 sixes.

translations.source: ‘Yan wasan kurket na tsakiya, Sachin Tendulkar da Rahul Dravid, sun yi kokari kuma sun yi haɗin gwiwa tare a Tseren-ɗari.
translations.reference: Middle order batsmen, Sachin Tendulkar and Rahul Dravid, performed well and made a hundred-run partnership.
translations.hypothesis: The central batsmen, Sachin Tendulkar and Rahul Dravid, both performed well and worked together effectively in the series.

translations.source: Amma, bayan rashin nasarar kyaftin din wicket Indiya kawai tayi asarar guda 36 tana kwance wickets 7 don kawo karshen innings.
translations.reference: But, after losing the captain's wicket India only made 36 runs loosing 7 wickets to end the innings.
translations.hypothesis: However, after losing the toss, India was only able to score 36 runs before losing 7 wickets, bringing the innings to a close.

translations.source: Shugaban kasar America George W. Bush ya iso Singapore a safiya 16 ga Nuwanba, domin fara yawon bude ido na tsawon mako daya a Asiya.
translations.reference: U.S. President George W. Bush arrived in Singapore the morning of November 16, beginning a week-long tour of Asia.
translations.hypothesis: The President of the United States, George W. Bush, arrived in Singapore on the morning of November 16th, to begin a one-week tour of Asia.

translations.source: Mataimakin Firayi Ministan Singapore Wong Kan Sang ne ya tarbe shi, sannan su ka tattauna al’amuran kasuwanci da ta’addanci tare da Firayi Ministan Singapore Lee Hsien Loong.
translations.reference: He was greeted by Singapore's Deputy Prime Minister Wong Kan Seng and discussed trade and terrorism issues with the Singapore Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong.
translations.hypothesis: The Deputy Prime Minister of Singapore, Wong Kan Seng, met with Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong, and they discussed matters related to trade and counter-terrorism.

translations.source: Bayan mako guda da shan kaye a zabukan tsakiyar wa’adi, Bush ya fada wa wasu magoya baya fadadar kasuwanci a Asiya.
translations.reference: After a week of losses in the midterm election, Bush told an audience about the expansion of trade in Asia.
translations.hypothesis: A week after losing the midterm elections, Bush spoke to a group of business leaders in Asia.

translations.source: Firayi Minista Stephen Harper, ya amince da aika kudurin ‘Dokar “Tsarkakakkiyar Iska’ zuwa ga kwamitin gamayyar jam’iyyu don sake dubawa, kafin ayi mata karatu na biyu, bayan taron mintuna 25 na ranar Talata tare da shugaban jam’iyyar NDP Jack Layton a PMO.
translations.reference: Prime Minister Stephen Harper has agreed to send the government's 'Clean Air Act' to an all-party committee for review, before its second reading, after Tuesday's 25 minute meeting with NDP leader Jack Layton at the PMO.
translations.hypothesis: Prime Minister Stephen Harper has agreed to send the "Clean Air Act" bill to a committee for further review before its second reading, following a 25-minute meeting on Tuesday with NDP leader Jack Layton at the Prime Minister's Office.

translations.source: Layton ya nemi canje-canje ga dokar ra’ayin mazan jiya yanayi lokacin haduwa da Firayim Ministan, yana tambaya don “cikakken sake rubutawar” dokan Jam'iyyar ra’ayin mazan jiya.
translations.reference: Layton had asked for changes to the conservatives' environmental bill during the meeting with the PM, asking for a "thorough and complete rewriting" of the Conservative party's environmental bill.
translations.hypothesis: Layton called for changes to the Conservative Party's environmental policy during a meeting with the Prime Minister, asking for a "complete rewrite" of the party's environmental platform.

translations.source: Tun daga lokacin da Gwamnatin Tarayya ta shiga daukar nauyin asibitin Mersey da ke Devonport, Tasmania, gwamnatin jihar da wasu ‘yan majalisar tarayya sun soki wannan aikin a matsayin ci gaban shirin zaben tarayya da za a kira a watan Nuwamba.
translations.reference: Ever since the Federal Government stepped in to take over funding of the Mersey hospital in Devonport, Tasmania, the state government and some federal MPs have criticised this act as a stunt in the prelude to the federal election to be called by November.
translations.hypothesis: Since the federal government took over the Mersey Hospital in Devonport, Tasmania, the state government and some federal parliamentarians have criticized the move, viewing it as a political maneuver ahead of the upcoming federal election in November.

translations.source: Amma Firayim Minista John Howard ya ce dokar an yi ta ne domin kare ginin asibitin domin kada gwamnatin Tasmania ta rage masa kima, wajen kara kudaden da dala miliyan 45 ta Australiya.
translations.reference: But Prime Minister John Howard has said the act was only to safeguard the facilities of the hospital from being downgraded by the Tasmanian government, in giving an extra AUD$45 million.
translations.hypothesis: However, Prime Minister John Howard stated that the law was enacted to protect the hospital project from being downsized by the Tasmanian government, particularly in light of the proposed additional funding of 45 million Australian dollars.

translations.source: Labari na baya bayan nan ya nuna cewa, nazarin motsin teku na nuna alamun wata tsunami ta taso. Hakika an tabbatar da alamun tsunami a kusa da Pago da Niue.
translations.reference: According to the latest bulletin, sea level readings indicated a tsunami was generated. There was some definite tsunami activity recorded near Pago Pago and Niue.
translations.hypothesis: Recent reports indicate that an analysis of sea movements has revealed signs of a potential tsunami. In fact, tsunami warnings have been issued for areas near Pago and Niue.

translations.source: Ba a sami wata mummunar barna ko jin ciwo a rahoton da ke fitowa daga Tonga ba, amma kuma wutar lantarki ta katse, abinda ya hana hukumomi samun sanarwar gargadin tsunami wanda hukumar PTWC ta bayar.
translations.reference: No major damage or injuries have been reported in Tonga, but power was temporarily lost, which reportedly prevented Tongan authorities from receiving the tsunami warning issued by the PTWC.
translations.hypothesis: There were no reports of significant damage or injuries coming from Tonga, but the power supply was cut off, which prevented authorities from receiving the tsunami warning issued by the PTWC (Pacific Tsunami Warning Center).

translations.source: An rufe duk makarantu goma sha hudu a Huawaii wadanda suke kusa da bakin teku a ranar Laraba duk da cewa an janye jan kunnen.
translations.reference: Fourteen schools in Hawaii located on or near coastlines were closed all of Wednesday despite the warnings being lifted.
translations.hypothesis: All fourteen schools located near the coast in Hawaii were closed on Wednesday, despite the lifting of the tsunami advisory.

translations.source: Shugaban Amurka George W. Bush ya yi maraba da sanarwar.
translations.reference: U.S. President George W. Bush welcomed the announcement.
translations.hypothesis: U.S. President George W. Bush welcomed the announcement.

translations.source: Mai magana da yawun Bush Gordon Johndroe ya kira alwashin da Koriya ta Arewa ta yi “babban mataki ne ga burin cimma nasarar narkar da makaman nukiliya na zirin Koriya.”
translations.reference: Bush spokesman Gordon Johndroe called North Korea's pledge "a major step towards the goal of achieving the verifiable denuclearization of the Korean peninsula."
translations.hypothesis: White House spokesperson Gordon Johndroe called North Korea's pledge "a significant step towards the goal of achieving the complete, verifiable, and irreversible denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula."

translations.source: Guguwar teku ta goma da aka sakawa suna Jerry a kakar guguwar tekun Atalantika ta fara a yau.
translations.reference: The tenth named storm of the Atlantic Hurricane season, Subtropical Storm Jerry, formed in the Atlantic Ocean today.
translations.hypothesis: The tenth tropical storm of the Atlantic hurricane season, named Jerry, has formed and is currently active.

translations.source: Cibiyar kula da guguwar teku ta kasa (NHC) ta ce a yanzu guguwar Jerry ba ta da wani hadari ga doron kasa.
translations.reference: The National Hurricane Center (NHC) says that at this point Jerry poses no threat to land.
translations.hypothesis: The National Hurricane Center (NHC) has stated that the current hurricane, Jerry, does not pose a threat to land.

translations.source: {Ungiyar Injiniya ta Amurka ta kiyasta cewa inci 6 na ruwan sama zai iya keta ragowar guguwar da ta gabata.
translations.reference: The U.S. Corps of Engineers estimated that 6 inches of rainfall could breach the previously damaged levees.
translations.hypothesis: The American Society of Civil Engineers estimates that 6 inches of rainfall could potentially worsen the effects of the previous flood.

translations.source: Unguwa ta tara, wacce ta ga ambaliyar ruwa har sama da ƙafa 20 a lokacin Guguwar Katrina, a halin yanzu tana cikin ruwa mai ɗumbin yawa yayin da levee na kusa ya cika.
translations.reference: The Ninth Ward, which saw flooding as high as 20 feet during Hurricane Katrina, is currently in waist-high water as the nearby levee was overtopped.
translations.hypothesis: The ninth ward, which was flooded with water up to 20 feet during Hurricane Katrina, is now experiencing significant flooding as the nearby levee has been breached.

translations.source: Ruwa na zubewa kan levee a sashi mai fadin kafa 100.
translations.reference: Water is spilling over the levee in a section 100 feet wide.
translations.hypothesis: Water is flowing over the levee in a section that is 100 feet wide.

translations.source: Mai Gudanarwa na Ƙaramar Majalisa Adam Cuerden ya nuna ɓacin ransa a game da sharewa a lokacin da ya ke magana da Wikinews a watan da ya gabata.
translations.reference: Commons Administrator Adam Cuerden expressed his frustration over the deletions when he spoke to Wikinews last month.
translations.hypothesis: The Chief Executive of the Local Council, Adam Cuerden, expressed his disappointment regarding the cuts while speaking to Wikinews last month.

translations.source: “Tun daga farko [Wales] ta yi mana karya. Na farko, ta hanyar yin kamar wannan saboda dalilai ne na doka. Na biyu, ta hanyar yin kamar yana sauraron mu, har zuwa goge fasaharsa.”
translations.reference: "He [Wales] basically lied to us from the start. First, by acting as if this was for legal reasons. Second, by pretending he was listening to us, right up to his art deletion."
translations.hypothesis: "From the very beginning, [Wales] has deceived us. First, by pretending to do something for legal reasons. Second, by pretending to listen to us, all the way to erasing their own expertise."

translations.source: Fushin al’ummar ya kai ga ƙoƙarin da ake yi na samar da tsari dangane da al’amuran da suka jibanci jima’i a shafin da ke daukar miliyoyin kafafen yada labarai da ke da lasisi.
translations.reference: The community irritation led to current efforts to draft a policy regarding sexual content for the site which hosts millions of openly-licensed media.
translations.hypothesis: The public outcry has led to efforts to establish regulations regarding content that is sexually suggestive or explicit, particularly on platforms that host millions of users and licensed media outlets.

translations.source: Mafi yawancin aiki da aka yi a rubuce ne, amma an tsara tsarin ne domin bunkasa lura da ake wa taurarin Sagittarius.
translations.reference: The work done was mostly theoretical, but the program was written to simulate observations made of the Sagittarius galaxy.
translations.hypothesis: Most of the work was documented, but the system was designed to improve the observation of the Sagittarius constellation.

translations.source: Tasirin da ƙungiyar ke nema zai haifar ne ta hanyar ƙarfi tsakanin igiyar ruwa tsakanin galaxy da Milky Way mai duhu.
translations.reference: The effect the team was looking for would be caused by tidal forces between the galaxy's dark matter and the Milky Way's dark matter.
translations.hypothesis: The impact the organization is seeking would be caused by a collision between a stream of dark matter and the Milky Way galaxy.

translations.source: Kamar yadda maganadisun wata ya ke jan duniya, inda hakan ke haddasa murɗawar igiyar ruwa, haka dabakar milky way ke tasiri kan dabakar saggitarius.
translations.reference: Just like the moon exerts a pull on the earth, causing tides, so does the Milky Way exert a force on the Sagittarius galaxy.
translations.hypothesis: Just as the gravitational pull of a planet can affect the surrounding space, similarly, the Milky Way galaxy exerts a gravitational influence on the Sagittarius constellation.

translations.source: Masana kimiyya sun yanke kan cewa dark matter tana yin tasirin akan wasu dark matter a yanayi iri daya da yadda sauran regular matter yakeyi.
translations.reference: The scientists were able to conclude that the dark matter affect other dark matter in the same way regular matter does.
translations.hypothesis: Scientists have concluded that dark matter interacts with other dark matter in a similar way to how ordinary matter interacts with itself.

translations.source: Wannan ka'idar tana cewa mafi akasarin duhun da ke kusa da galaxy ana samun shi ne a kusa da galaxy a wani nau'in halo, kuma an yi shi da kananan kananan kwayoyi.
translations.reference: This theory says that most dark matter around a galaxy is located around a galaxy in a kind of halo, and is made of lots of small particles.
translations.hypothesis: This theory states that the majority of the dark matter near a galaxy is found in a sort of halo surrounding the galaxy, and it is composed of weakly interacting massive particles.

translations.source: Rahotannin talabijin sun nuna farin hayaki na fitowa daga shukar.
translations.reference: Television reports show white smoke coming from the plant.
translations.hypothesis: Television reports showed thick smoke billowing from the factory.

translations.source: Mahukuntan yankin suna gargadin mazauna yankin da ke kusa da masana’antar da su kasance cikin gidajensu, a kashe na’urorin sanyaya ɗaki kuma kada a sha ruwan famfo.
translations.reference: Local authorities are warning residents in the vicinity of the plant to stay indoors, turn off air-conditioners and not to drink tap water.
translations.hypothesis: Local authorities are advising residents living near the industrial plant to stay indoors, turn off their air conditioners, and avoid drinking tap water.

translations.source: A cewar hukumar nukiliya ta Japan, an gano sinadaran caesium da iodine masu hadari a ma’aikatar.
translations.reference: According to Japan's nuclear agency, radioactive caesium and iodine has been identified at the plant.
translations.hypothesis: According to the Japanese nuclear agency, traces of the radioactive elements cesium and iodine have been detected in the facility.

translations.source: Hukumomi suna hasashen cewa wannan yana nuna cewa mai yiwuwa gangunan da a ke ajiye man uranium a wurin sun fashe kuma suna zuba.
translations.reference: Authorities speculate that this indicates that containers holding uranium fuel at the site may have ruptured and are leaking.
translations.hypothesis: Authorities believe this indicates that the storage tanks containing uranium may have ruptured and are leaking.

translations.source: Dokta Tony Moll ya gano kwayar cutar tarin fuka (XDR-TB) a yankin Afirka ta Kudu KwaZulu-Natal.
translations.reference: Dr. Tony Moll discovered the Extremely Drug Resistant Tuberculosis (XDR-TB) in the South African region KwaZulu-Natal.
translations.hypothesis: Dr. Tony Moll has discovered the extensively drug-resistant strain of tuberculosis (XDR-TB) in the KwaZulu-Natal region of South Africa.

translations.source: A cikin wata hira, ya ce sabuwar cutar “na da matukar tada hankali da firgitarwa saboda yawan mace-macen da ta ke haddasawa.”
translations.reference: In an interview, he said the new variant was "very highly troubling and alarming because of the very high fatality rate."
translations.hypothesis: In an interview, he stated that the new disease "is extremely concerning and alarming due to the number of complications it causes."

translations.source: Kila wasu marasa lafiya sun kamu da cutar a asibiti, Dokta Moll yana tsammani, kuma aƙalla biyu sun kasance ma'aikatan kiwon lafiya na asibiti.
translations.reference: Some patients might have contracted the bug in the hospital, Dr. Moll thinks, and at least two were hospital health workers.
translations.hypothesis: It is possible that some patients contracted the disease in the hospital, Dr. Moll believes, and at least two of them were healthcare workers at the hospital.

translations.source: Nan da shekara ɗaya, mutum daya mai ɗauke da cutar zai shafa ma mutane 10 zuwa 15 da suka kusance shi.
translations.reference: In one year's time, an infected person may infect 10 to 15 close contacts.
translations.hypothesis: Within a year, a single person infected with the disease can spread it to 10 to 15 people who are in close contact with them.

translations.source: Sai dai, kashin XDR-TB da ke jikin duk rukunin mutane da ke da tarin fuka har yanzu da alamar yana ƙasa; 6,000 daga cikin jimillar mutane 330,000 da suka kamu a kowane lokaci a Afirka ta Kudu.
translations.reference: However, the percentage of XDR-TB in the entire group of people with tuberculosis still seems to be low; 6,000 of the total 330,000 people infected at any particular moment in South Africa.
translations.hypothesis: However, the XDR-TB strain, which affects people with weakened immune systems, is still present; 6,000 out of a total of 330,000 people infected in South Africa at any given time.

translations.source: Taurarin dan adam ɗin, waɗanda duka biyun nauyinsu ya haura da ƙarin fam 1,000, kuma suke tafiyar kimanin mil 17,500 a sa'a guda, sun yi karo da juna mil 491 sama da Duniya.
translations.reference: The satellites, both of which weighed in excess of 1,000 pounds, and traveling at approximately 17,500 miles per hour, collided 491 miles above the Earth.
translations.hypothesis: The two human-made objects, each weighing over 1,000 pounds, and traveling at approximately 17,500 miles per hour, collided about 491 miles above the Earth.

translations.source: Masana kimiyya sun ce fashewar da hatsarin ya haifar na da girma.
translations.reference: Scientists say the explosion caused by the collision was massive.
translations.hypothesis: Scientists say the explosion caused by the accident was significant.

translations.source: Har yanzu suna ƙoƙarin gano yadda girman hatsarin ya kasance da kuma yadda abin zai shafi Duniya.
translations.reference: They are still trying to determine just how large the crash was and how the Earth will be affected.
translations.hypothesis: They are still working to determine the extent of the damage and how it will impact the world.

translations.source: Hukumar Dabaru ta Amurka wato United States Strategic Command ta Ofishin Tsaron Amurka tana bin diddigin ɓarɓashi.
translations.reference: The United States Strategic Command of the U.S. Department of Defense office is tracking the debris.
translations.hypothesis: The United States Strategic Command, a component of the U.S. Department of Defense, is monitoring cyber threats.

translations.source: Sakamakon binciken za'a futo dashi ne shafin yanar gizo wanda kowa zai iya gani.
translations.reference: The result of plotting analysis will be posted to a public website.
translations.hypothesis: The results of the research will be published on a website that anyone can access.

translations.source: Hukumomi a Ohio sun sanar da cewa wata likita wadda ke aiki a wani asibiti a Pittsburg, za’a caje ta da laifin kisan kai bayan an gano gawar mahaifiyarta a mace a wajen ajiye kaya na bayan motar ta ranar Laraba.
translations.reference: A doctor who worked at Children's Hospital of Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania will be charged with aggravated murder after her mother was found dead in the trunk of her car Wednesday, authorities in Ohio say.
translations.hypothesis: Authorities in Ohio have announced that a doctor working at a hospital in Pittsburgh will be charged with murder after the body of her mother was found in the cargo area of her car on Wednesday.

translations.source: An gano Dokta Malar Balasubramanian, 29, a cikin Blue Ash, Ohio, wani yanki kusa da kilomita 15 arewacin Cincinnati kwance a ƙasa kusa da hanya a cikin T-shirt da tufafi a cikin halain tsananin daukan magani.
translations.reference: Dr. Malar Balasubramanian, 29, was found in Blue Ash, Ohio, a suburb approximately 15 miles north of Cincinnati lying on the ground beside the road in a T-shirt and underwear in an apparently heavily medicated state.
translations.hypothesis: Dr. Malar Balasubramanian, 29, was found in Blue Ash, Ohio, a suburb about 15 miles north of Cincinnati. She was lying on the ground near a road, wearing a T-shirt and pants, and appeared to be in a state of severe intoxication.

translations.source: Ta tura jami’an zuwa bakin motar ta kerar Oldmobile wacce take diddigen kafafu 500 daga inda take.
translations.reference: She directed officers to her black Oldsmobile Intrigue which was 500 feet away.
translations.hypothesis: She sent officers to the scene of the accident, which involved a car, an Oldsmobile, that had traveled approximately 500 feet before coming to a stop.

translations.source: A can, suka tarar da gawar Saroja Balasubramanian, 53, an lulluɓe da barguna na jini.
translations.reference: There, they found the body of Saroja Balasubramanian, 53, covered with blood-stained blankets.
translations.hypothesis: In a shocking turn of events, the body of Saroja Balasubramanian, 53, was found covered in blood.

translations.source: ‘Yan sanda sun ce da alama gawar ta kai tsawon kwana daya a wurin.
translations.reference: Police said that the body appeared to have been there for about a day.
translations.hypothesis: Police say it appears the body had been there for about a day.

translations.source: An ba da rahoton kamuwa da cutar na farko a wannan kakar a karshen Yuli.
translations.reference: The first cases of the disease this season were reported in late July.
translations.hypothesis: The first case of the disease this season was reported at the end of July.

translations.source: Aladu ke dauke da kwayar cutar, wadda ke yin kaura zuwa jikin mutane daga sauro.
translations.reference: The disease is carried by pigs, which then migrates to humans through mosquitos.
translations.hypothesis: Ticks carry bacteria that can be transmitted to humans through bites.

translations.source: Annobar ta sa gwamnatin Indiya daukar waɗannan matakai kamar tura masu kamun alade zuwa yankunan da abin ya fi shafa, raba dubban labulen sauro da kum fesa maganin ƙwari.
translations.reference: The outbreak has prompted the Indian government to undertake such measures as deployment of pig catchers in seriously affected areas, distributing thousands of mosquito curtains and spraying pesticides.
translations.hypothesis: The outbreak prompted the Indian government to take these measures, including deploying medical teams to the most affected areas, distributing thousands of mosquito nets, and spraying insecticide.

translations.source: Gwamnati ta alkawarin miliyoyin kwalaben rigakafin encephalitis, wanda zai taimaka wajen shirya hukumomin kiwon lafiya a shekara mai zuwa.
translations.reference: Several million vials of encephalitis vaccine have also been promised by the government, which will help prepare health agencies for next year.
translations.hypothesis: The government has pledged millions of doses of encephalitis vaccine, which will help prepare healthcare facilities for the coming year.

translations.source: An dakatar da shirye-shiryen kai alluran rigakafi zuwa yankunan da abin ya fi shafa a tarihi a wannan shekara saboda rashin kuɗaɗe da kuma ƙarancin bayar da muhimmanci dangane da sauran cututtuka.

translations.source: Wasan karshe ne na All Blacks, wanda tuni ya lashe kofin makonni biyu da suka gabata.
translations.reference: It was the final match for the All Blacks, who had already won the trophy two weeks ago.
translations.hypothesis: This is the final match for the All Blacks, who have already won the championship in the past two weeks.

translations.source: Wasan karshe na rukunin zai gudana ne a Ellis Park a Johannesburg mako mai zuwa, lokacin da Springboks za ta buga da Australia.
translations.reference: The final match of the series will take place at Ellis Park in Johannesburg next week, when the Springboks play Australia.
translations.hypothesis: The final match of the tournament will be held at Ellis Park in Johannesburg next week, where the Springboks will play against Australia.

translations.reference: A moderate earthquake shook western Montana at 10:08 p.m. on Monday.

translations.source: Babu wani rahoto game da lalacewa nan take da Nazarin Yanayin Kasa na Amurka (USGS) da kuma Cibiyar Bayar da Bayani game da Girgizar Kasa suka samu.
translations.reference: No immediate reports of damage have been received by the United States Geological Survey (USGS) and its National Earthquake Information Center.

translations.source: Girgizar kasar ta fi kamari ne a tsakanin kilomita 20 (wato mil 15) a arewacin arewa maso gabas da kuma kimanin kilomita 65 (wato mil 40) kudu da Buttle.

translations.source: Nau’in cutar murar tsuntsaye mai hadari ta H5N1, an tabbatar ita ce ta kama agwagwar daji wadda aka samu ranar lahadi a wani surkuki kusa da garin Lyon da ke gabashin Faransa.
translations.reference: The strain of bird flu lethal to humans, H5N1, has been confirmed to have infected a dead wild duck, found on Monday, in marshland near Lyon in the east of France.
translations.hypothesis: The highly pathogenic H5N1 strain of bird flu has been confirmed as the cause of the disease that affected a wild bird found on Sunday in a forest near the city of Lyon in eastern France.

translations.source: Faransa ce kasa ta bakwai a cikin Tarayyar Turai da ke fama da wannan cutar; sun bi Austria, Jamus, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Girka da Italiya.
translations.reference: France is the seventh country in the European Union to suffer this virus; following Austria, Germany, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Greece and Italy.
translations.hypothesis: France is the seventh country in the European Union to be affected by this disease; they follow Austria, Germany, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Greece, and Italy.

translations.source: Har yanzu ba’a tabbatar da yawan mutane da ake zargi da kamuwa da H5N1 a Croatia da Denmark.
translations.reference: Suspected cases of H5N1 in Croatia and Denmark remain unconfirmed.
translations.hypothesis: As of now, the exact number of people suspected of being infected with the H5N1 virus in Croatia and Denmark has not been confirmed.

translations.source: Chambers ta yi karan Ubangiji saboda “yaɗuwar mutuwa ko’ina, halakawa da ta’addanci akan miliyoyin mutanen duniya.”
translations.reference: Chambers had sued God for "widespread death, destruction and terrorization of millions upon millions of the Earth's inhabitants."
translations.hypothesis: Chambers prayed for God, citing "the pervasive death, suffering, and violence inflicted upon millions of people around the world."

translations.source: Majalisa, wani bafulatani, ya bayar da hujjar cewa karar shi “ba ta da kyau” kuma “kowa na iya tuhumar wani.”
translations.reference: Chambers, an agnostic, argues that his lawsuit is "frivolous" and "anybody can sue anybody."
translations.hypothesis: The legislator, a conservative, argued that the lawsuit was "unjust" and that "anyone can accuse anyone."

translations.source: Labarin da Camille Saint-Saenstar ya gabatar a wasan dandamali na Faransa,na wani shahararren mai fasaha ne wanda “wanda rayuwarsa ta ta’allaka kan soyayyarsa da kwaya da kasar Japan”
translations.reference: The story presented in the French opera, by Camille Saint-Saens, is of an artist "whose life is dictated by a love for drugs and Japan."
translations.hypothesis: The opera presented by Camille Saint-Saëns in France tells the story of a renowned artist whose life is deeply intertwined with his love for women and his fascination with Japan.

translations.source: A sakamakon haka, masu wasan kan sha tabar wiwi akan dandamalin wasan, kuma shi kansa gidan wasan yana baiwa masu kallo ƙarfin guiwar yin haka.
translations.reference: As a result, the performers smoke cannabis joints on stage, and the theatre itself is encouraging the audience to join in.
translations.hypothesis: As a result, players often experience a sense of euphoria on the playing field, and the stadium itself contributes to this feeling, encouraging spectators to feel the same way.

translations.source: Tsohon kakakin majalisar Newt Gingrich, gwamnan Texas Rick Perry, da uwargidan majalisar wakilai, Michele Bachmann sun gama a mataki na hudu, na biyar, da na shida, bi da bi.
translations.reference: Former House Speaker Newt Gingrich, Texas governor Rick Perry, and Congresswoman Michele Bachmann finished in fourth, fifth, and sixth place, respectively.
translations.hypothesis: Former House Speaker Newt Gingrich, Texas Governor Rick Perry, and Representative Michele Bachmann finished in fourth, fifth, and sixth place, respectively.

translations.source: Bayan sakamakon ya shigo, Gingrich ya yaba wa Santorum, amma yana da kalmomi masu wuya ga Romney, wanda a madadinsa aka gabatar da tallan kamfe mara kyau a Iowa da Gingrich.
translations.reference: After the results came in, Gingrich lauded Santorum, but had tough words for Romney, on whose behalf negative campaign advertisements were aired in Iowa against Gingrich.
translations.hypothesis: After the results came in, Gingrich praised Santorum, but he had harsh words for Romney, who had previously been presented as a strong opponent to Gingrich in Iowa.

translations.source: Perry ya fadi cewa zai “dawo Texas domin tantance sakamakon caucus na daren nan, in tantance ko akwai ko akwai alaman ci gaba man a wannan tsere”, amma daga baya ya ce zai ci gaba da tseren sannan ya yi gasan fid da gwani ran 21 ga Janairu a South Carolina.
translations.reference: Perry stated that he would "return to Texas to assess the results of tonight's caucus, determine whether there is a path forward for myself in this race", but later said that he would remain in the race and compete in the January 21 South Carolina primary.
translations.hypothesis: Perry stated that he would "return to Texas to assess the results of tonight's caucuses and determine whether there are any signs of momentum in this race," but later said that he would continue campaigning and participate in the primary election on January 21st in South Carolina.

translations.source: Bachmann, wanda ya lashe zaben Ames Straw Poll a watan Agusta, ya yanke shawarar kawo karshen kamfen din ta.
translations.reference: Bachmann, who won the Ames Straw Poll in August, decided to end her campaign.
translations.hypothesis: Bachmann, who won the Ames Straw Poll in August, has decided to end her campaign.

translations.source: An mayar da mai daukan hoton zuwa asibitin Ronarld Reagan UCLA Medical Center, inda ya mutu.

translations.hypothesis: The photographer was taken to the Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Center, where he died.

translations.source: An ruwaito cewa yana cikin shekaran sa na 20 ne. A cikin wata sanarwa, Bieber ya ce “duk da ya ke ba na wurin kuma ba ni da hannu kai tsaye cikin wannan mummunan hadarin, tunani da addu'o’ina suna tare da dangin waɗanda abin ya rutsa da su.”
translations.reference: He was reportedly aged in his 20s. In a statement, Bieber said "[w]hile I was not present nor directly involved with this tragic accident, my thoughts and prayers are with the family of the victim."
translations.hypothesis: Reports indicate that he is in his early 20s. In a statement, Bieber said, "Although I was not present and had no direct involvement in this tragic accident, my thoughts and prayers are with the families of those affected."

translations.source: Shagin yanar-gizo na labarun nishaɗi na TMZ ya fahimta cewa mai ɗaukar hoto ɗin ya tsayar da motsarsa a tsallaken titin Sepulveda Boulevard kuma ya yi ƙoƙarin ɗaukar hotuna na tsayawar ƴan sanda kafin ya tsallaka titin kuma ya ci gaba, wanda ya sa ɗan sanda na Sintirin Babbar Hanya ta California wanda yake ba da hannu ya umarce shi ya koma a ƙetare, sau biyu.
translations.reference: Entertainment news website TMZ understands the photographer stopped his vehicle on the other side of Sepulveda Boulevard and attempted to take pictures of the police stop before crossing the road and continuing, prompting the California Highway Patrol police officer conducting the traffic stop to order him back across, twice.
translations.hypothesis: TMZ, the celebrity gossip website, reported that the photographer stopped in the middle of Sepulveda Boulevard and attempted to take pictures of the police activity before crossing the street and continuing on. This caused a California Highway Patrol officer, who was assisting at the scene, to order him to pull over twice.

translations.source: Bisa ga fadin yan sanda, direban motan da ya buge mai hoton na iya fuskantan zargin aikata laifi.
translations.reference: According to police, the driver of the vehicle that hit the photographer is unlikely to face criminal charges.
translations.hypothesis: According to police reports, the driver of the car that hit the photographer may face criminal charges.

translations.source: Da lambobin yabo goma sha takwas kacal da ake da su a rana, kasashe da dama sun gaza kaiwa ga dandamalin bada lambar yabo.
translations.reference: With only eighteen medals available a day, a number of countries have failed to make the medal podium.
translations.hypothesis: With only eighteen Nobel Prizes awarded each year, many countries fail to be recognized by this prestigious award system.

translations.source: Sun hada da Netherlands, yayin da Anna Jochemsen ta kammala a ta tara a jerin ajin mata a Super-G jiya, da Finland yayin da Katja ke kammalawa a na goma duk a bikin.
translations.reference: They include the Netherlands, with Anna Jochemsen finishing ninth in the women's standing class in the Super-G yesterday, and Finland with Katja Saarinen finishing tenth in the same event.
translations.hypothesis: The Netherlands was represented, with Anna Jochemsen finishing ninth in the women's Super-G event yesterday, and Finland, as Katja finished tenth in the same competition.

translations.source: Mitchell Gourley na Ostiraliya ya gama na goma sha ɗaya a cikin tsayuwar Super-G na maza. Ɗan gasar Czech Oldrich Jelinek ya gama na goma sha shida a cikin Super-G na zaunen maza.
translations.reference: Australia's Mitchell Gourley finished eleventh in the men's standing Super-G. Czech competitor Oldrich Jelinek finished sixteenth in the men's sitting Super-G.
translations.hypothesis: Mitchell Gourley of Australia finished in 11th place in the men's Super-G event. Czech competitor Oldrich Jelinek finished in 16th place in the men's seated Super-G.

translations.source: Arly Velasquez na kasar Mexico ya ƙare a matsayin na goma sha biyar a jerin Super-G na maza na zaune. Adam Hall na New Zealand ya ƙare a matsayin na tara a Suƙer-G na maza na tsaye.
translations.reference: Arly Velasquez of Mexico finished fifteenth in the men's sitting Super-G. New Zealand's Adam Hall finished ninth in the men's standing Super-G.
translations.hypothesis: Arly Velasquez of Mexico finished in 15th place in the men's seated Super-G. Adam Hall of New Zealand finished in 9th place in the men's standing Super-G.

translations.source: Mazaje na Poland masu fama da rashin gani a wasan ƙwallon ƙafa Maciej Krezel da jagorar Anna Ogarzynska sun gama na goma sha uku a gasar Super-G. Jong Seork Park na Koriya ta Kudu ya kammala na ashirin da huɗu a gasar maza ta Super-G.

translations.hypothesis: Polish skiers Maciej Krezel, led by Anna Ogarzynska, finished in 13th place in the Super-G competition. Jong Seork Park of South Korea finished in 24th place in the men's Super-G event.

translations.source: Ana tuhumar ma'aikatun majalisar dinkin duniya da suka zo Haiti bayan girgizar kasar shekarar2010 da yada cutuka wayenda suka fara ne daga kusa da mazaunar su.
translations.reference: UN peacekeepers, whom arrived in Haiti after the 2010 earthquake, are being blamed for the spread of the disease which started near the troop's encampment.
translations.hypothesis: United Nations peacekeepers who were deployed to Haiti after the 2010 earthquake are accused of spreading a cholera epidemic that originated near their base.

translations.source: A cewar karar, ba a tsaftace bata daga zangon UN kamar yadda ya kamata ba, ya haddasa kwayoyin cuta shigan ruwa wadda yake kwarara cikin Rafin Artibonite, daya daga ciki babba a Haiti.
translations.reference: According to the lawsuit, waste from the UN camp was not properly sanitized, causing bacteria to enter the tributary of the Artibonite River, one of Haiti's largest.
translations.hypothesis: According to the lawsuit, sewage was not properly treated at the UN facility, causing pathogens to enter the Artibonite River, a major waterway in Haiti.

translations.source: Kafin isowar sojoji, Haiti bata taba fuskantar matsalolin da suka shafi cutar ba tun a shekarun 1800s.
translations.reference: Prior to the arrival of troops, Haiti had not encountered problems related to the disease since the 1800s.
translations.hypothesis: Before the arrival of the soldiers, Haiti had not faced such significant health challenges since the 1800s.

translations.source: Cibiyar Tabbatar da Adalci da Demokradiyya ta ƙasar Haiti ta nakalto waɗansu ayyukan nazari masu zaman kansu waɗanda ke tsammanin bataliyar kiyaye zaman lafiya ta Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya da ke Nepal ce ta kawo cutar Haiti bisa rashin sani.
translations.reference: The Haitian Institute for Justice and Democracy has referenced independent studies that suggest the Nepalese UN peacekeeping battalion unknowingly brought the disease to Haiti.
translations.hypothesis: The Haitian Center for Justice and Democracy has cited several independent reports that suggest the peacekeeping force of the United Nations in Nepal is responsible for introducing cholera to Haiti, due to a lack of awareness.

translations.source: Danielle Lantagne, ƙwararriyar masaniyar Majalisar Dinkin Duniya kan cutar, ta bayyana cewa mai yiyuwa ne sojojin kiyaye zaman lafiya suka haifar da cutar.
translations.reference: Danielle Lantagne, a UN expert on the disease, stated the outbreak was likely caused by the peacekeepers.
translations.hypothesis: Danielle Lantagne, a leading expert on global health at the United Nations, has suggested that peacekeeping forces may have inadvertently caused the outbreak.

translations.source: Hamilton ya tabbatar da Asibitin Jami'ar Howard ya ba da haƙuri a cikin kwanciyar hankali.
translations.reference: Hamilton confirmed Howard University Hospital admitted the patient in stable condition.
translations.hypothesis: Hamilton confirmed that Howard University Hospital provides excellent care and a peaceful environment.

translations.source: Marar lafiyar ya je Najeriya, inda aka samu wasu sun kamu da cutar ta Ebola.
translations.reference: The patient had been to Nigeria, where some cases of the Ebola virus have occurred.
translations.hypothesis: The disease spread to Nigeria, where some people contracted the Ebola virus.

translations.source: Asibitin ta bi ka’idoji na kula da kamuwa da cuta, tare da raba masu jiyya daga sauran jama’a domin hana yaduwan cutan.
translations.reference: The hospital has followed protocol for infection control, including separating the patient from others to prevent possible infection of others.
translations.hypothesis: The hospital follows strict infection control protocols, separating patients from the general public to prevent the spread of disease.

translations.source: Kafin Simpsons Simon ya yi aiki a kan shirye-shirye da yawa a wurare daban-daban.

translations.hypothesis: Before working on The Simpsons, Simon had worked on various programs in different places.

translations.source: A lokacin 1980s yayi aiki a kan shirye-shirye kamar Taxi, Cheers, da The Tracy Ullman Show.

translations.hypothesis: During the 1980s, he worked on shows such as Taxi, Cheers, and The Tracy Ullman Show.

translations.source: A cikin 1989 ya taimaka ƙirƙirar Simpsons tare da Brooks da Groening, kuma shi ke da alhakin ɗaukar ƙungiyar masu rubutu na farko.
translations.reference: In 1989 he helped create The Simpsons with Brooks and Groening, and was responsible for hiring the show's first writing team.
translations.hypothesis: In 1989, he helped create The Simpsons with Brooks and Groening, and he was responsible for assembling the original writing team.

translations.source: Duk da barin wasan shirin a 1993 an cigaba da kiransa shugaban shiri, kuma ya cigaba da karbar miliyoyin daloli a kowace kaka na kamasho.

translations.hypothesis: Despite being discontinued in 1993, the show continued to be referred to as the "flagship program," and it continued to generate millions of dollars in revenue each season.

translations.source: Tun farko kamfanin dillacin labarai na China Xinhua ya ba da rahoton wani jirgin da aka sace.

translations.hypothesis: Initially, the Chinese news agency Xinhua reported the hijacking of an aircraft.

translations.source: Hadarin jirgin sama ya zama ruwan dare a Iran, sakamakon tsoffin jirage wadanda ba a kula da su na ayyukan farar hula da sojoji.

translations.hypothesis: Aviation accidents have become a recurring problem in Iran, largely due to the use of aging aircraft for both civilian and military operations.

translations.source: Takunkumin ƙasa da ƙasa na nufin ba za a iya sayan sabon jirgin sama ba.

translations.hypothesis: The international sanctions mean that it will be impossible to purchase a new aircraft.

translations.reference: Earlier this week, a police helicopter crash killed three people and wounded three more.
translations.hypothesis: Earlier this week, a police helicopter crashed, resulting in the deaths of three people and injuries to another three.

translations.hypothesis: Last month, Iran experienced its worst disaster in years when a passenger plane en route to Armenia crashed, killing all 168 people on board.

translations.source: A dai wannan watan ne wani jirgin saman ya kauce daga kan titin da jirgi yake tafiya a kai kafin tsahinsa a Mashad inda ya bugi wata katanga, tare da kashe mutum sha bakwai.

translations.hypothesis: This month, an airplane veered off the runway while taxiing at Mashhad airport before taking off, colliding with a fence and killing seventeen people.

translations.source: Aerosmith sun soke sauran kade-kade a yawon shakatawansu.
translations.reference: Aerosmith have cancelled their remaining concerts on their tour.
translations.hypothesis: Aerosmith surprised their fans during their tour.

translations.source: Ƙungiyar makaɗan rock za ta fara yawon kaɗe-kaɗe a Amurka da Canada har zuwa 16 ga Satumba.

translations.hypothesis: The rock band will begin its North American tour in the United States and Canada, starting on September 16th.

translations.source: Potro ya sami kulawa a kafadarsa a wannan lokacin amma ya sami nasarar komawa wasan.
translations.reference: Potro received treatment to his shoulder at this point but managed to return to the game.
translations.hypothesis: The player had been receiving treatment for a leg injury, but he managed to return to the game.

translations.source: An fara shirin da karfe 8:30 na yamma (15.00 UTC).

translations.source: A lokacin gabatar da babban bayani na ranar Alhamis a Nunin Wasan Tokyo, shugaban Nintendo Satoru Iwata ya kaddamar da tsarin sarrafawa na sabuwar na’urar Nintendo Re volution.

translations.hypothesis: Like television signals, remote controls use two sensors placed near the television to detect their presence.

translations.source: Wannan zai bai wa masu wasannin bidiyo damar sarrafa wasan ta hanyar motsi da na’urar a cikin iska.
translations.reference: This will allow players to control actions and movements in video games by moving the device through the air.
translations.hypothesis: This will allow video game players to control the game using motion and a device in the air.

translations.source: Motar Giancarlo Fisichella ta kwace masa inda hakan ya jawo fitarsa daga tseren jim kaɗan bayan farawa.

translations.hypothesis: Giancarlo Fisichella's car had a problem, which caused him to fall behind early in the race.
