translations.reference: His teammate Fernando Alonso was in the lead for most of the race, but ended it right after his pit-stop, probably because a badly tucked right front wheel.
translations.hypothesis: Fernando Alonso, his main rival, was leading the race, but he had to pit, possibly due to damage to the right front wing.

translations.source: Michael Schumacher ya gama tserensa ba da daɗewa ba bayan Alonso, saboda lalacewar dakatarwa a yaƙe-yaƙe da yawa yayin tseren.
translations.reference: Michael Schumacher ended his race not long after Alonso, because of the suspension damage in the numerous battles during the race.
translations.hypothesis: Michael Schumacher finished the race shortly after Alonso, but he was held back due to multiple pit stop penalties during the race.

translations.source: “Tana da kyau sannan tana waka da kyau, kuma,” ya bayana bisa ga kwafi na taron masu yada labaru.
translations.reference: "She’s very cute and sings quite well, too," he said according to a transcript of the news conference.
translations.hypothesis: "She is beautiful and sings beautifully, and," he stated, according to a transcript of the press conference.

translations.source: “An motsa ni kowane lokacin da muke yin maimaitawa kan wannan, daga cikin zuciya ta.”
translations.reference: "I was moved every time we did a rehearsal on this, from the bottom of my heart."
translations.hypothesis: "Every time we revisit this topic, it touches me deeply."

translations.source: Kimanin mintuna 3 da harba jirgin, na’urara daukan hoton da ke ciki ta nuna yadda wani soson kariya ya balle daga jikin tankin mai.
translations.reference: Around 3 minutes into the launch, an on-board camera showed numerous pieces of insulation foam break away from the fuel tank.
translations.hypothesis: Approximately 3 minutes into the flight, the onboard camera showed a protective shield deploying from the fuel tank.

translations.source: Duk da haka, ba'a tunanin cewa sun haifar da wata ɓarna ga abin sufurin.
translations.reference: However, they are not thought to have caused any damage to the shuttle.
translations.hypothesis: However, it is not believed that they caused any significant damage to the vehicle.

translations.source: Babban jami'in shirin rufe jirgin NASA, N. Wayne Hale Jr. ya ce kumburin ya fadi “bayan lokacin da muke damuwa.”
translations.reference: NASA's shuttle program chief N. Wayne Hale Jr. said the foam had fallen "after the time we are concerned about."
translations.hypothesis: The NASA program's chief engineer for the space shuttle program, N. Wayne Hale Jr., said the swelling occurred "after the time we were concerned."

translations.source: Mintuna biyar da fara nunin wata iska ya fara shigowa ciki, kusan minti daya daga baya, iskar ta doshi 70km/h... daga baya ruwan sama yazo, amma da yawa da ƙarfinsa ya sauko yadda zai bugi fatarka kamar allura, saannan wani kankara ya fado daga sama, mutane suna firgita suna kururuwa suna tattake juna.
translations.reference: Five minutes into the display a wind starts rolling in, about a minute later, the wind is reaching 70km/h... then the rain comes, but so hard and so large that it slaps your skin like a needle, then hail fell from the sky, people panicking and screaming and running over each other.
translations.hypothesis: Five minutes before the show started, a strong wind began to blow. About a minute later, the wind reached speeds of 70 km/h. Then, it started to rain, but the raindrops were so large and heavy that they felt like being hit by pellets. Suddenly, a large piece of debris fell from the sky, and people screamed and panicked, huddling together for safety.

translations.source: Na rasa yar uwata tare da kawarta, kuma a hanya na gamu da wasu nakasassu biyu a kan keke, jama’a suna ta tsallake su tare da tura su,” inji Armand Versace.
translations.reference: I lost my sister and her friend, and on my way there were two disabled people in wheelchairs, people just jumping over and pushing them," Armand Versace said.
translations.hypothesis: "I lost my sister and her friend, and on the way, I encountered two people with disabilities on bicycles, and people were constantly passing them and pushing them," said Armand Versace.

translations.source: NHK ta kuma ruwaito cewa masana’antar samar da makamashin nukiliya ta Kashiwazaki Kariwa a gundumar Niigata tana aiki yadda yakamata.
translations.reference: NHK also reported that the Kashiwazaki Kariwa nuclear power plant in Niigata prefecture was operating normally.
translations.hypothesis: NHK also reported that the Kashiwazaki-Kariwa nuclear power plant, located in the Niigata prefecture, is operating normally.

translations.source: Kamfanin Hokuriku Electric Power Co. ya ba da rahoton babu wata illa daga girgizar kasar kuma an rufe matatar mai lamba 1 da 2 a tashar makamashin nukiliyar ta Shika.
translations.reference: Hokuriku Electric Power Co. reported no effects from the earthquake and that the Number 1 and 2 reactors at its Shika nuclear power plant were shut down.
translations.hypothesis: Hokuriku Electric Power Co. reported that there were no damages from the earthquake, and reactors 1 and 2 at the Shika nuclear power plant have been shut down.

translations.source: An ba da rohoto cewa gidaje 9400 a yankin ba su da ruwa sannan kusan 100 ba su da lantarki.
translations.reference: It is reported that some 9400 homes in the region are without water and approximately 100 without electricity.
translations.hypothesis: It has been reported that 9,400 households in the area lack access to water, and approximately 100 households lack access to electricity.

translations.source: Wasu hanyoyi sun lalace, al'amuran jirgin kasa ya katse a wuraren da abin ya shafa, kuma Filin jirgin saman Noto da ke yankin Ishikawa ya kasance a rufe.
translations.reference: Some roads have been damaged, railway service interrupted in the affected areas, and the Noto Airport in Ishikawa prefecture remains closed.
translations.hypothesis: Some roads are damaged, train services have been suspended in affected areas, and the Komatsu Airport in the Ishikawa region is currently closed.

translations.source: Wani bam ɗaya ya fashe a wajen ofishin gwamna-janar.
translations.reference: One bomb exploded outside the governor general's office.
translations.hypothesis: A bomb exploded near the governor-general's office.

translations.source: Karin Bama-bamai uku sun fashe kusa a gine-ginen gwamnati a cikin tsawon sa’aoi biyu.
translations.reference: Three more bombs exploded near government buildings in a period of two hours.
translations.hypothesis: Three explosions occurred near government buildings within a two-hour period.

translations.source: Wasu rahotanni sun kai adadin mutuwan zuwa takwas, kuma tabbatacciyar rahoto na tabbatar da cewa mutum 30 suka ji rauni; amma ba a san adadin ƙarshe ba.
translations.reference: Some reports put the official death toll at eight, and official reports confirm that up to 30 were injured; but final numbers are not yet known.
translations.hypothesis: Reports indicate that the death toll has reached eight, and confirmed reports state that 30 people have been injured; however, the final number is still unknown.

translations.source: Dukkanin cyanuric acid da melamine an same su ne a cikin kayan fitsari daga dabbobin gidan da suka mutu bayan sun sha gurbataccen abincin dabbobi.
translations.reference: Both cyanuric acid and melamine were found in urine samples from pets that died after consuming contaminated pet food.
translations.hypothesis: Both cyanuric acid and melamine were found in pet food products that caused the deaths of several pets after they consumed contaminated pet food.

translations.source: Magungunan biyu suna aiki tare da juna don samar da lu'ulu'u wanda zai iya toshe aikin koda, masu bincike a jami'ar sun ce.
translations.reference: The two compounds react with one another to form crystals that may block kidney function, researchers at the university said.
translations.hypothesis: The two drugs work together synergistically to create a compound that can block the activity of certain enzymes, researchers at the university said.

translations.source: Masu binciken sun lura cewa kiristal sun taru a fisarin kyanwa ta hanyar karin sinadarin melanin da cyanuric.
translations.reference: The researchers observed crystals formed in cat urine by the addition of melamine and cyanuric acid.
translations.hypothesis: Researchers have observed that crystals form in the evening by adding melanin and cyanuric acid.

translations.source: Jumlar sanfurin gilashin suna kama da wanda aka samu a fitsarin dabbar yayin da aka kafa a na’urar infrared spectroscopy (FTIR).
translations.reference: The composition of these crystals matches those found in the urine of affected pets when compared by infrared spectroscopy (FTIR).
translations.hypothesis: The spectral characteristics of the glass samples are similar to those observed in the reference spectrum obtained using infrared spectroscopy (FTIR).

translations.source: Ban sani ba ko kun gane shi ko a'a, amma yawancin kayayyaki daga Amurka ta Tsakiya sun shigo wannan ƙasa ba tare da biyan haraji ba.
translations.reference: I don't know if you realize it or not, but most of the goods from Central America came into this country duty-free.
translations.hypothesis: I'm not sure if you're aware of this, but a significant amount of goods from Central America are entering this country without being subject to taxes.

translations.source: Duk da haka kashi tamanin cikin kayan mu sun samu haraji a kasashen Amurka ta tsakiya. Zamu kula da kai.
translations.reference: Yet eighty percent of our goods were taxed through tariffs in Central American countries. we treat you.
translations.hypothesis: However, eighty percent of our products are subject to tariffs in Central American countries. We will take care of that for you.

translations.source: Na kasa fahimtar abin, hakika babu adalci a ciki.
translations.reference: That didn't seem to make sense to me; it certainly wasn't fair.
translations.hypothesis: I can't understand this; it's clearly unfair.

translations.source: Kawai abin da na ke ce wa mutane shine ku bi da mu yadda muke bi da ku.
translations.reference: All I say to people is you treat us the way we treat you.
translations.hypothesis: All I'm saying is, please treat us the way we treat you.

translations.source: Gwamnan California Arnold Schwarzenegger ya sanya hannu a cikin wata doka da ta hana sayarwa ko hayar wasannin bidiyo mai tashin hankali ga ƙananan yara.
translations.reference: California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger signed into law a bill that bans the sale or rental of violent video games to minors.
translations.hypothesis: California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger has signed a law that prohibits the sale or rental of violent video games to minors.

translations.source: Dokar na bukatar a sanya wa wasannin bidiyo na tashin hankali da ake sayarwa a jihar California alama da ke nuna “18” inda ya zamo sayar da su ga kananan yara laifi ne mai jawo hukuncin tarar $1000 a kowane laifi.
translations.reference: The bill requires violent video games sold in the state of California to be labeled with a decal reading "18" and makes their sale to a minor punishable by a fine of $1000 per offense.
translations.hypothesis: The law requires that video games marketed in the state of California that contain potentially offensive content be labeled with a "18" rating, and selling these games to minors is now a crime punishable by a fine of $1000 per violation.

translations.source: Darektan gabatar da kara na hukumar, Kier Starmer QC, a safiyar yau ya sanar da gurfanar da mutanen biyu, Huhne da Pryce, a gaban shari’a.
translations.reference: The Director of Public Prosecutions, Kier Starmer QC, gave a statement this morning announcing the prosecution of both Huhne and Pryce.
translations.hypothesis: This morning, Kier Starmer QC, the Director of Public Prosecutions, announced that two individuals, Huhne and Pryce, will be charged in court.

translations.source: Huhne ya yi murabus kuma za a maye gurbinsa a Majalisar da Dan Majalisa Ed Davey. Ana tsammanin Dan Majalisa Norman Lamb zai zama Ministan Kasuwanci aikin da Job Davey zai ajiye.
translations.reference: Huhne has resigned and he will be replaced in the Cabinet by Ed Davey MP. Norman Lamb MP is expected to take the Business Minister job Davey is vacating.
translations.hypothesis: Huhne has resigned, and he will be replaced in Parliament by MP Ed Davey. It is expected that MP Norman Lamb will become the Minister for Business, a position that Job Davey will be vacating.

translations.source: Huhne da Pryce an shirya za su bayyana a Kotun Majistare ta Westminster a ranar 16 ga Fabrairu.
translations.reference: Huhne and Pryce are scheduled to appear at the Westminster Magistrates Court on February 16.
translations.hypothesis: Huhne and Pryce are scheduled to appear at Westminster Magistrates' Court on February 16th.

translations.source: Wandanda suka rasu sun hada da Nicholas Alden dan shekara 25, da Zachary Cuddeback mai shekara 21. Cuddeback ya kasance mai tukin.
translations.reference: The fatalities were Nicholas Alden, 25, and Zachary Cuddeback, 21. Cuddeback had been the driver.
translations.hypothesis: The deceased include 25-year-old Nicholas Alden and 21-year-old Zachary Cuddeback. Cuddeback was a truck driver.

translations.source: Edgar Veguilla ya sami raunuka a hannusa da muƙamuƙi yayin da aka bar Kristoffer Schneider yana buƙatar tiyata ta gyaran fuskar sa.
translations.reference: Edgar Veguilla received arm and jaw wounds while Kristoffer Schneider was left requiring reconstructive surgery for his face.
translations.hypothesis: Edgar Veguilla sustained injuries to his hands and legs, while Kristoffer Schneider required surgery to repair his face.

translations.source: Makamin Uka ya kasa yayin da yake auna kan mutum na biyar. Schneider na da raɗaɗi da ke gudana, makanta a ido daya, wani bangaren ƙoƙon kai da ya ɓata da fuska da aka sake ginawa daga titanium.
translations.reference: Uka's weapon failed whilst pointed at a fifth man's head. Schneider has ongoing pain, blindness in one eye, a missing section of skull and a face rebuilt from titanium.
translations.hypothesis: The soldier collapsed as he measured the vital signs of the fifth person. Schneider was twitching, his eyes rolled back, and he had a broken arm and a disfigured face, reconstructed with titanium.

translations.source: Schneider ya ba da shaida ta wurin video link daga tashar USAF a kasarsa na haihuwa.
translations.reference: Schneider testified via videolink from a USAF base in his homeland.
translations.hypothesis: Schneider provided evidence through a video link from a USAF base in his country of origin.

translations.source: Bayan abubuwan da suka faru a ranar Laraba, Carpanedo ya yi gasa a tsere guda biyu a wasannin neman zakara.
translations.reference: Beyond Wednesday's event, Carpanedo competed in two individual races at the Championships.
translations.hypothesis: Following the events of Wednesday, Carpanedo competed in two more matches in the championship games.

translations.source: Na farko ita ce Slalom, inda ta samu nasarar Ba ta inarshe ba a wasanninta na farko. 36 daga cikin gasa 116 sun sami irin wannan sakamakon a wannan tseren.
translations.reference: Her first was the Slalom, where she earned a Did Not Finish in her first run. 36 of the 116 competitors had the same result in that race.
translations.hypothesis: First, there was the Slalom event, where she didn't qualify for the next round. Out of the 116 competitors, 36 experienced the same outcome in this event.

translations.source: Sauran tseren nata, Giant Slalom, ta ga ta gama a matsayi na goma a rukunin mata tare da saurin gudu na 4: 41.30, 2: 11.60 a hankali fiye da na farkon da ta kammala mai Austrian Claudia Loesch da minti 1: 09.02 a hankali fiye da na tara. Gyöngyi Dani na Hungary.
translations.reference: Her other race, the Giant Slalom, saw her finish in tenth in the women's sitting group with a combined run time of 4:41.30, 2:11.60 minutes slower than first place finisher Austrian Claudia Loesch and 1:09.02 minutes slower than the ninth place finisher Gyöngyi Dani of Hungary.
translations.hypothesis: In the other event, the Giant Slalom, she finished tenth in the women's category with a time of 4:41.30, 2:11.60 slower than the winner, Austrian Claudia Loesch, who finished in 1:09.02, and 1:09.02 slower than the ninth-place finisher, Hungarian Gyöngyi Dani.

translations.source: Hudu daga cikin masu tsere a kungiyar mata sun gaza kamala gudu, kuma 45 a cikin 117 masu tsere a Giant Slalom sun kasa samun nasara a tseren.
translations.reference: Four skiers in the women's sitting group failed to finish their runs, and 45 of the 117 total skiers in the Giant Slalom failed to rank in the race.
translations.hypothesis: Four of the female skiers in the team failed to finish the race, and 45 out of the 117 skiers in the Giant Slalom did not qualify for the next round.

translations.source: ‘Yan sandan Madhya Pradesh sun karbo laptop da wayar hannu da aka sace.
translations.reference: The Madhya Pradesh Police recovered the stolen laptop and mobile phone.
translations.hypothesis: Police in Madhya Pradesh have recovered a stolen laptop and mobile phone.

translations.source: D K Arya, mataimakin Sufeto Janar ya ce, “Mun kama mutane biyar da suka yi wa yar kasar Switzerland fyade kuma an gano wayarta ta hannu da kwamfutar taa
translations.reference: Deputy Inspector General D K Arya said, "We have arrested five persons who raped the Swiss woman and recovered her mobile and laptop".
translations.hypothesis: D.K. Arya, the Deputy General Superintendent, stated, "We have apprehended five individuals who sexually assaulted a Swiss national, and her phone and laptop have been recovered."

translations.source: Wadanda ake zargin sun hada da Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar da Vishnu Kanjar.
translations.reference: The accused are named as Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar and Vishnu Kanjar.
translations.hypothesis: The individuals implicated include Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar, and Vishnu Kanjar.

translations.source: Sufiritendan ‘yan sanda Chandra Shekhar Solanki ya ce wanda ake zargin ya gurfana gaban kotu - fuska rufe.
translations.reference: Police superintendent Chandra Shekhar Solanki said the accused appeared in court with covered faces.
translations.hypothesis: Police officer Chandra Shekhar Solanki stated that the suspect, who appeared in court, had his face covered.

translations.source: Kodayake mutane uku ke ciki lokacin da motar ta yi karo da gidan, amma ba wanda da ya ji rauni a cikinsu.
translations.reference: Although three people were inside the house when the car impacted it, none of them were hurt.
translations.hypothesis: Although there were three people inside the car when it crashed into the building, none of them were injured.

translations.source: Koyaya, direban yana ɗaukar munanan raunuka a kan sa.
translations.reference: However, the driver sustained serious injuries to the head.
translations.hypothesis: However, the driver sustained serious injuries.

translations.source: Titin da akayi hatsarin yana rufe na dan wani lokaci yayin da musa aikin gaggawa  suke ceto mutumin daga cikin jar Audi TT.
translations.reference: The road where the crash happened was temporarily closed while emergency services freed the driver from the red Audi TT.
translations.hypothesis: The road was temporarily closed while emergency services worked to rescue the person trapped inside the Audi TT.

translations.source: Da farko an kwantar da shi a asibitin James Paget da ke Great Yarmouth.
translations.reference: He was initially hospitalised in the James Paget Hospital in Great Yarmouth.
translations.hypothesis: Initially, he was admitted to the James Paget Hospital in Great Yarmouth.

translations.source: Daga baya aka canja masa wurin zuwa Asibitin Addenbrooke wanda yake Cambridge.
translations.reference: He was subsequently relocated to Addenbrooke's Hospital in Cambridge.
translations.hypothesis: Later, he was transferred to Addenbrooke's Hospital, which is located in Cambridge.

translations.source: Tuni Adekoya ke Kotun Edinburgh in da a ke tuhumarta da kashe danta.
translations.reference: Adekoya has since been in Edinburgh Sheriff Court charged with murdering her son.
translations.hypothesis: Adekoya is currently in court in Edinburgh, where she is being tried for the murder of her son.

translations.source: Tana tsare kafin shigar da kara da kuma hukunci, amma ko wani shaidar wanda ya agni da ido zai iya zama gurbatacce saboda yadda aka yada hoton ta.
translations.reference: She is in custody pending indictment and trial, but any eyewitness evidence may be tainted because her image has been widely published.
translations.hypothesis: She was presumed innocent until proven guilty, but even with evidence that would normally clear her, she could still be condemned because of the way her image has been portrayed.

translations.source: Wannan shi ne abin gama gari a wasu wurare a cikin Ingila amma adalci na Scottish yana aiki daban kuma kotunan suna kallon wallafa hotunan a matsayin mai yuwuwar wariya.
translations.reference: This is common practice elsewhere in the UK but Scottish justice works differently and courts have viewed publication of photos as potentially prejudicial.
translations.hypothesis: This is common practice in some parts of England, but Scottish law operates differently, and courts often view the publication of photos as a potential breach of privacy.

translations.source: Farfesa Pamela Ferguson na Jami'ar Dundee ta lura “ƴan jarida na ganin kamar suna tafiya ne a wani layi mai hadari idan wallafa hotuna da sauransu wadanda ake zargi.”
translations.reference: Professor Pamela Ferguson of the University of Dundee notes "journalists do seem to be walking a dangerous line if publishing photos etc of suspects."
translations.hypothesis: Professor Pamela Ferguson of the University of Dundee observed that "journalists appear to be walking a dangerous line when publishing photos and other materials that are potentially defamatory."

translations.source: Ofishin gabatar da Ƙararraki, wanda ke da alhakin gabatar da tuhuma, ya bayyana wa ‘yan jarida cewa ba shi da wani bayani da zai kara har sai bayan an karbi shigar da karar.
translations.reference: Crown Office, which is in overall charge of prosecutions, has indicated to journalists that no further comment will be made at least until indictment.
translations.hypothesis: The office responsible for filing charges has informed journalists that it has no further information to release until the formal complaint is received.

translations.source: Takardar, gwargwadon fallasar, za ta yi magana ne kan rikicin iyakoki, wanda Falasɗinawa ke son ya ɗora shi kan iyakokin kafin Yaƙin Gabas ta Tsakiya na 1967.
translations.reference: The document, according to the leak, will refer to the borders dispute, which Palestine wants based on the borders before the 1967 Mideast War.
translations.hypothesis: The document, according to reports, concerns the border dispute, which Palestinians want to extend to the borders that existed before the 1967 Six-Day War.

translations.source: Sauran batu da aka tattauna bisa ga fadi sun hada da Jerusalem a nan gaba wadda ke da tsarki ga al’umma biyun tare da batun Jordan Valley.
translations.reference: Other topics covered reportedly include the future state of Jerusalem which is sacred to both nations and the Jordan Valley issue.
translations.hypothesis: Other issues discussed, according to the report, included the future of Jerusalem, a city holy to both peoples, and the issue of the Jordan Valley.

translations.source: Isra'ila ta bukaci sojoji su ci gaba da kasancewa a kwarin na tsawon shekaru goma matukar an rattaba hannu yayin da hukumar falasdinawa ta amince da barin irin wannan kasancewar na tsawon shekaru biyar kacal.
translations.reference: Israel demands an ongoing military presence in the valley for ten years once an agreement is signed while the PA agrees to leave such presence only for five years.
translations.hypothesis: Israel has demanded that the military maintain its presence in the West Bank for a period of ten years, provided an agreement is reached, while the Palestinian Authority has agreed to a maximum period of five years for such a presence.

translations.source: Maharba masu aikin gwajin maganin kwari, zasu kasance karkashin kulawar malaman gandun daji, yayin gwajin domin tantance ingancinsa.
translations.reference: Shooters in the supplementary pest control trial were to be closely supervised by rangers, as the trial was monitored and its effectiveness evaluated.
translations.hypothesis: The bees used in honey testing will be under the care of beekeepers during the testing process, which is designed to assess the quality of the honey.

translations.source: A cikin haɗin gwiwar NPWS da Sportungiyar Sporting Shooters Association of Australia (NSW) Inc, an ɗauki ƙwararrun masu sa kai, a ƙarƙashin shirin wasannin kungiyar maharba.
translations.reference: In a partnership of NPWS and the Sporting Shooters Association of Australia (NSW) Inc, qualified volunteers were recruited, under the Sporting Shooters Association's hunting program.
translations.hypothesis: In collaboration with the National Parks and Wildlife Service (NPWS) and the Sporting Shooters Association of Australia (NSW) Inc., experienced shooters are being engaged as part of the ranger program.

translations.source: A cewar Mick O'Flynn, na'ibin Daraktan na Park Conservation da Heritage tare da NPWS, maharban guda hudu da aka zaba don aikin harbi na farko sun sami cikakken tsaro da horo.
translations.reference: According to Mick O'Flynn, the Acting Director Park Conservation and Heritage with the NPWS, the four shooters selected for the first shooting operation received comprehensive safety and training instruction.
translations.hypothesis: According to Mick O'Flynn, the Director of Park Conservation and Heritage at NPWS, the four rangers selected for the initial deployment have received comprehensive training and are fully equipped.

translations.source: Martelly ya rantsar da sabuwar Kwamitin Zabe na Wucin-gadi (CEP) mai membobi guda tara.
translations.reference: Martelly swore in a new Provisional Electoral Council (CEP) of nine members yesterday.
translations.hypothesis: Martelly swore in the new nine-member Provisional Electoral Council (CEP).

translations.source: Shi ne CEP Matelly na biyar cikin shekara hudu.
translations.reference: It is Martelly's fifth CEP in four years.
translations.hypothesis: He is the fifth CEP (Chief Executive Officer) in four years.

translations.source: A watan da ya gabata ne wani kwamiti na shugaban kasa ya ba da shawarar murabus din CEP tun gabani a matsayin bangare na kunshin daukar matakan ciyar da kasar gaba zuwa sabon zabe.
translations.reference: Last month a presidential commission recommended the prior CEP's resignation as part of a package of measures to move the country towards new elections.
translations.hypothesis: Last month, a presidential committee recommended the dissolution of the CEP (presumably an electoral body) as part of a package of measures aimed at preparing the country for upcoming elections.

translations.source: Kwamitin ya kasance martanin Martelly ne game da yaɗuwar zanga-zangar adawa da tsarin mulki da aka fara a watan Oktoba.
translations.reference: The commission was Martelly's response to widespread anti-regime protests that started in October.
translations.hypothesis: The committee's report was a response to the wave of protests against the government that began in October.

translations.source: Zanga-zangar da wani lokaci suke da tashin hankali sun faru ne saboda gaza yin zaɓuɓɓuka, waɗansu lokacinsu ya wuce tun 2011.
translations.reference: The sometimes-violent protests were triggered by failure to hold elections, some due since 2011.
translations.hypothesis: Protests, which can sometimes be tense, often occur due to unmet demands, and some of these demands date back to 2011.

translations.source: An ba da rohoton iPods da ba sa aiki kusan 60 saboda yawan ɗaukar zafi, wannan ya haddasa gobara har guda shida tare da barin mutane hudu da kananan ƙuna.
translations.reference: Around 60 cases of malfunctioning iPods overheating have been reported, causing a total of six fires and leaving four people with minor burns.
translations.hypothesis: Reports indicate that approximately 60 iPods malfunctioned due to overheating, causing a fire that spread to six vehicles and resulted in injuries to four people, including minor burns.

translations.source: Ma’aikatar tattalin arziki, Ciniki da Masana’antu ta Japan (METI) ta ce tana sane da hatsarurruka guda 27 da ke da alaƙa da na’urorin.
translations.reference: Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) said that it had been aware of 27 accidents related to the devices.
translations.hypothesis: The Japanese Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) has stated that it is aware of 27 incidents related to the devices.

translations.source: Dustin “Goldust” Runnels ta yi sharhi cewa “Luna ta kasance mai rauni sosai kamar ni ... wataƙila ma fiye da haka ... ƙaunace ta zai batar da ita ... da fatan tana cikin wuri mafi kyau.”

translations.source: Daga cikin mutane 1,400 da aka jefa kuri’a gabanin zaben tarayya na 2010, wadanda ke adawa da Australia ta zama jamhuriya sun karu da kashi 8 cikin 100 tun daga shekarar 2008.
translations.reference: Out of 1,400 people polled prior to the 2010 federal election, those who oppose Australia becoming a republic grew by 8 per cent since 2008.
translations.hypothesis: Out of the 1,400 people surveyed before the 2010 federal election, the proportion of those who oppose Australia becoming a republic increased by 8 percentage points since 2008.

translations.source: Minista mai rikon kwarya Julia Gillard ta yi ikirarin a lokacin yakin neman zaben shekarar 2010 cewa ya yi imani Australia za ta zama jamhuriya a karshen mulkin Sarauniya Elizabeth II.
translations.reference: Caretaker Prime Minister Julia Gillard claimed during the campaign of the 2010 federal election that she believed Australia should become a republic at the end of Queen Elizabeth II's reign.
translations.hypothesis: During the 2010 election campaign, then-Deputy Prime Minister Julia Gillard stated that she believed Australia would become a republic after the reign of Queen Elizabeth II.

translations.source: kashi 34 na wadanda ke cikin jin ra’ayoyin suna da ra’ayi kamar wannan, son Sarauniya Elizabeth II ta zama mai sarauta ta karshe a Australia.
translations.reference: 34 per cent of those in the poll share this view, wanting Queen Elizabeth II to be Australia's last monarch.
translations.hypothesis: According to a recent poll, 34% of respondents share the opinion that Queen Elizabeth II should be the last monarch in Australia.

translations.source: Jin ra’ayoyin jama’a ya nuna cewa kaso 29 na mutanen Australiya na goyon bayan zamanta jamhuriyya cikin gaggawa yayin da kaso 31 kuma ke sukar ra’ayin ta zama jamhuriya.
translations.reference: At the extremes of the poll, 29 per cent of those surveyed believe Australia should become a republic as soon as possible, while 31 per cent believe Australia should never become a republic.
translations.hypothesis: Public opinion polls indicate that 29% of Australians strongly support the idea of becoming a republic, while 31% are opposed to the idea of a republic.

translations.source: Wanda ya lashe lambar zinare a gasar Olympics ya kamata ne ya yi iyo a tseren mita 100 da 200 kuma a cikin wasanni uku a wasannin Commonwealth, amma saboda korafin da ya yi ya nuna shakku kan lafiyar sa.

translations.source: Mai yiwuwa taurari masu wutsiya sun kasance ta cikinsu ruwan sama ke zuwa duniya tare da takin dabbobi wanda ke iya samar da kayan gina jiki domin tallafar rayuwa.

translations.hypothesis: It is possible that comets, as they travel through space, bring water to Earth along with organic matter that could provide the building blocks for life.

translations.source: Masana kimiyya suna fatan fahimtar yadda taurari suke samuwa, musamman yadda Duniya ta samu, tunda taurari masu wutsiya suka yi karo da duniya lokaci mai tsawo da ya gabata.

translations.hypothesis: Scientists are hoping to understand how planets are formed, particularly how Earth came to be, since a fiery object collided with Earth a long time ago.

translations.source: Cuomo, mai shekaru 53, ya fara mulkin sa a farkon wannan shekarar kuma ya sanya hannu kan wata doka a watan da ya halatta auren jinsi.

translations.hypothesis: The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had a water supply system with a drain in almost every house, which was connected to a sophisticated sewage system.

translations.source: Hakanan akwai bandakuna a zamanin d Misira, Farisa da China. A cikin wayewar Roman, wasu lokuta bayan gida wani bangare ne na gidajen wanka na jama'a inda maza da mata suke tare a cikin haɗin gwiwa.

translations.reference: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away, you are using a satellite.
translations.hypothesis: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away, you are using human ingenuity.

translations.hypothesis: A human figure appears in the sky, seemingly summoned, and then quickly disappears.

translations.hypothesis: It uses a telescope with a mirror over 100 feet long to collect light and bring distant objects in space into view.

translations.source: Gare garen ta canza duniyan a hanyoyi na ban mamaki. Abu mafi girma da gare garen ta yi mana shine ta bamu hanyoyi masu sauki na sufuri.

translations.hypothesis: Transportation has transformed the world in remarkable ways. The most significant impact of transportation is that it has provided us with more convenient ways to travel.

translations.source: Lamarin ne ya kawo mana jirgin kasa, mota da hanyoyin sufuri da dama.
translations.reference: It has brought us the train, the car, and many other transportation devices.
translations.hypothesis: This situation has led to disruptions in train services, road transportation, and various other modes of transport.

translations.source: Karkashin su akwai wasu maguna masu matsakaicin yanayi wadanda ke cin abinci mai madaidaicin yanayi wanda ya fara daga zomaye zuwa barewa da barewan daji.
translations.reference: Under them are more medium sized cats that eat medium sized prey ranging from rabbits to antelopes and deer.
translations.hypothesis: Underneath them, there are various types of herbivores that consume vegetation, ranging from grasses to shrubs and trees.

translations.source: Da karshe, akwai kananan kyanwoyi (da suka haɗa da kyanwoyin gida da suka gudu) da suke cin kananan naman da suka kama kamar kwari, ɓeraye, kadangaru, da tsuntsaye.
translations.reference: Finally, there are many small cats (including loose pet cats) that eat the far more numerous small prey like insects, rodents, lizards, and birds.
translations.hypothesis: Finally, there are smaller predators (including domestic animals like cats and dogs) that prey on smaller animals they catch, such as rodents, rabbits, birds, and lizards.

translations.source: Sirrin nasararsu ita ce tsarinsu na samun hutu, aiki na musamman da kowace kyanwa ke riko da shi domin kaucewa yin gasa da sauran.
translations.reference: The secret to their success is the concept of the niche, a special job each cat holds that keeps it from competing with others.
translations.hypothesis: The secret to their success lies in their strategy of finding a niche, a specific area where each individual can excel and avoid direct competition with others.

translations.source: Zakuna ne dangin mage da suka fi daɗin ma’amala, suna taruwa wuri ɗaya abin da ake kira iko.
translations.reference: Lions are the most social cats, living in large groups called prides.
translations.hypothesis: Families with strong connections and influence often gather together in a place of power.

translations.source: Garken zaki sun kunshi maza manya daya zuwa uku masu dangantaka, tare da mata da dama har zuwa talatin tare da ‘ya’ya.
translations.reference: Prides are made up of one to three related adult males, along with as many as thirty females and cubs.
translations.hypothesis: Harems typically consist of one to three adult males who are related, along with multiple women (up to thirty) and their children.

translations.source: Mata yawanci suna da kusanci da juna, kasancewa babban dangi na yan uwa da ƴaƴa mata.
translations.reference: The females are usually closely related to each other, being a large family of sisters and daughters.
translations.hypothesis: Women often have close relationships with each other, forming a strong family network of sisters and female relatives.

translations.source: Taruwar zakuna suna kamar rukunin kyar ko karnuka, dabbobi wanda suka yi kamar da zaki (amma ba sauran manyan kuliyoyi ba) a cikin hali, kuma suna da matukar cutarwa ga abincin su.
translations.reference: Lion prides act much like packs of wolves or dogs, animals surprisingly similar to lions (but not other big cats) in behavior, and also very deadly to their prey.
translations.hypothesis: Termites are social insects that resemble ants or cockroaches, and they live in colonies. They are highly destructive to wooden structures and other plant-based materials.

translations.source: Mai gudu sosai, damisa zai iya hawa (amma ba maikyau ba) yi iwo, tsalen nesa sosai da kuma ja so biya kamar kafin mutum.
translations.reference: A well rounded athlete, the tiger can climb (though not well), swim, leap great distances and pull with five times the force of a strong human.
translations.hypothesis: A very fast runner, a cheetah can climb (though not very well), cover long distances, and has a hunting strategy similar to that of a human.

translations.source: Damisar Tiger tana cikin rukuni guda (Genus Panthera) kamar zakuna, damisar leopards, da jaguars. Wadannan dangin kyanwar guda huɗu sune kaɗai su ke iya ruri.
translations.reference: The tiger is in the same group (Genus Panthera) as lions, leopards, and jaguars. These four cats are the only ones who can roar.
translations.hypothesis: The tiger belongs to the same genus (Panthera) as lions, leopards, and jaguars. These four species are the only ones capable of roaring.

translations.source: Rurin damisa bai yi kama da cikeke ƙarfin murya zaki ba, amma ya fi kama da gurnani na jimlar kalmomin da aka faɗa da ƙarfi.
translations.reference: The tiger's roar is not like the full-voiced roar of a lion, but more like a sentence of snarly, shouted words.
translations.hypothesis: The difficulty in understanding someone doesn't necessarily stem from a lack of volume in their voice, but rather from the complexity and nuance of the words they use.

translations.source: Ƴan wasa suna son cin kananan dabbobi. Za su kama birai, macizai, zazzage da tsuntsaye in sun iya. Kusan dukkan dabbobin da dutsen ya farauto suna ƙasa da shi.
translations.reference: Ocelots like to eat small animals. They will catch monkeys, snakes, rodents and birds if they can. Almost all of the animals that the ocelot hunts are far smaller than it is.
translations.hypothesis: Players enjoy hunting small animals. They might catch rabbits, cats, birds, and even lizards if they can. Almost all the animals that live in the area are preyed upon by them.

translations.source: Masana ilimin kimiyya suna tunanin cewa ocelots na bin dabbobi da kama su ta hanyar sansanar sawun inda su ka bi su ka wuce.
translations.reference: Scientists think that ocelots follow and find animals to eat (prey) by smell, sniffing for where they've been on the ground.
translations.hypothesis: Scientists believe that ocelots hunt and capture prey by stalking them and then ambushing them.

translations.source: Suna iya gani sosai cikin duhu tare da ganin na dare, kuma suna tafiya cikin sanɗa. Kyanwar daji na farautar abin farautar su ta hanyar sajewa da wurin da su ke sannan su dirar wa abin farautar su.
translations.reference: They can see very well in the dark with night vision, and move very stealthily, too. Ocelots hunt their prey by blending in with their surroundings then pouncing on their prey.
translations.hypothesis: They have excellent night vision and can move silently. Female deer attract mates through scent marking and vocalizations, and then they engage in courtship rituals.

translations.source: Yayin da wani karamin gungun dabbobi (jama’a kadan) su ka kasance sun rabu da babban gungun da su ke ciki (misali idan su ka koma kan wasu jerin tsaunuka, ko wani kogi ko kuma su ka koma wani sabon tsibirin yadda ba zasu iya komowa ba) akasari su kan sami kansu a muhalli na daban da inda su ka fito.
translations.reference: When a small group of living things (a small population) gets separated from the main population that they came from (like if they move over a mountain range or a river, or if they move to a new island so that they can't easily move back) they will often find themselves in a different environment than they were in before.
translations.hypothesis: When a small group of animals separates from the main herd (for example, if they migrate to a different mountain range, cross a river, or reach a new island that the rest cannot access), they often find themselves in a different environment than the one they are accustomed to.

translations.source: Wannan sabon muhallin yana da albarkatu daban da kuma masu gasa daban, don haka sabuwar al’umma za ta buƙaci mabambantan fasali ko karɓuwa don zama ƙaƙƙarfar mai gasafiye da abin da su ka buƙata a baya.
translations.reference: This new environment has different resources and different competitors, so the new population will need different features or adaptations to be a strong competitor than what they had needed before.
translations.hypothesis: This new environment presents different resources and different competitors, so the new community will need to develop different skills or adaptations in order to be a successful competitor and meet its needs in the future.

translations.source: Asalin al’umman basu canza ba ko kadan, suna bukatan karbuwa kamar da.
translations.reference: The original population hasn't changed at all, they still need the same adaptations as before.
translations.hypothesis: The original people have not changed at all; they still need to be treated with respect.

translations.source: A kan lokaci, yayin da sabbin yawan jama’a suka fara daidaita da sabon yanayin su, sai su fara dawo kadan da kadan kamar waɗancan yawan jama'a.
translations.reference: Over time, as the new population begins to adapt to their new environment, they start to look less and less like the other population.
translations.hypothesis: Over time, as new populations begin to adapt to their environment, they gradually start to resemble the established populations.

translations.source: A ƙarshe, bayan dubun dubbai ko ma shekaru miliyoyi, yawar jama’a biyu za su zauna da banbancin da ba za a kira su da wannan jinsin ba.
translations.reference: Eventually, after thousands or even millions of years, the two populations will look so different that they can't be called the same species.
translations.hypothesis: Eventually, after countless generations or even millions of years, the two populations will diverge to the point where they can no longer be considered the same species.

translations.source: Samar da sabon jinsi, hanya ce mai mahimmanci wadda ba za’a iya kauce mata ba a cikin tsarin asalin halittu.
translations.reference: We call this process speciation, which just means the formation of new species. Speciation is an unavoidable consequence and a very important part of evolution.
translations.hypothesis: Creating new species is a crucial and unavoidable process within the natural world.

translations.source: Shuke-shuke suna sanya iskar oxygen wanda mutane ke shaka, kuma suna shan iskar carbon-dioxide wanda mutane ke fitarwa (ma'ana fitar da iska).
translations.reference: Plants make oxygen which humans breathe, and they take in carbon-dioxide which humans exhale (that is, breathe out).
translations.hypothesis: Plants absorb oxygen that humans breathe, and they consume carbon dioxide, which is a gas that humans exhale.

translations.source: Tsire-tsire suna yin abincinsu daga rana ta hanyar hotuna. Suna kuma bayar da inuwa.
translations.reference: Plants make their food from the sun by photosynthesis. They also provide shade.
translations.hypothesis: Plants obtain their food from the sun through photosynthesis. They also release oxygen.

translations.source: Muna gina gidajenmu ne daga itatuwa kuma muna yin sitirunmu daga itatuwa. Mafi yawan abincin da muke ci daga tsirrai ne. Idan babu tsirrai, mutane da dabbobi ba za su rayu ba.
translations.reference: We make our houses from plants and make clothes from plants. Most foods that we eat are plants. Without plants, animals could not survive.
translations.hypothesis: We build our houses from wood, and we make our furniture from wood. Most of the food we eat comes from plants. Without plants, neither humans nor animals could survive.

translations.source: Mosasaurus ita ce babbar dabbar da ke farautar dabbobi a zamaninta, don haka bata fargabar komi ba, in ban da dabbobin Mosasaurs.
translations.reference: Mosasaurus was the apex predator of its time, so it feared nothing, except other mosasaurs.
translations.hypothesis: The Mosasaurus is the largest predator of its time, so it has nothing to fear, except perhaps other Mosasaurs.

translations.source: Dogon haban sa sun cika da hakora masu ci kamar reza sama da 70, tare da ƙarin saiti a cikin rufin bakinsa, ma'ana babu mafaka ga wani abu wanda ya ketare hanyar sa.
translations.reference: Its long jaws were studded with more than 70 razor-sharp teeth, along with an extra set in the roof of its mouth, meaning that there was no escape for anything that crossed its path.
translations.hypothesis: The long, narrow corridors are lined with shelves that reach over 70 feet high, with additional storage built into the ceiling, meaning there is virtually no wasted space.

translations.source: Bamuda tabbaci amma watakila yana da harshe me cokali me yatsu. abincin shi ya hada dodon kodi, manyan kifaye, da wasu masosaurs kuma zai iya akwai mai cin nama.
translations.reference: We don't know for sure, but it may have had a forked tongue. Its diet included turtles, large fish, other mosasaurs, and it may even have been a cannibal.
translations.hypothesis: It's a type of lizard, possibly with a spiky or textured skin. Its diet consists of large insects, possibly other lizards, and it might also eat meat.

translations.source: Ta na kai wa duk wani abu farmaki da ya shiga ruwan, ko da kuwa gabjejen kakan kadangare mai suna T.Rex ba zai iya ja da shi ba.
translations.reference: It also attacked anything that entered the water; even a giant dinosaur such as T. rex would be no match for it.
translations.hypothesis: It can withstand anything that comes into contact with it, even if it's something as powerful as a Tyrannosaurus Rex trying to pull it.

translations.source: Duk da yake yawancin abincinsu zai zama sananne gare mu, Romawa suna da nasu yankin na baƙin bukukuwa ko abubuwan biki da ba a saba da su ba, da suka haɗa da akuyar daji, dawisu, dodon-koɗi, da kuma wani nau’in ɓera da ake kira dormousee
translations.reference: While most of their food would be familiar to us, Romans did have their share of strange or unusual feast items, including wild boar, peacock, snails, and a type of rodent called a dormouse
translations.hypothesis: While much of their cuisine would be familiar to us, the Romans also had their own unique festive or celebratory dishes, including wild boar, dormice, sausages, and a type of small rodent called a dormouse.

translations.source: Wani banbamcin kuma shi ne talakawa da kuma mata sun cinye abincinsu yayin da suke zaune a kan kujeru, masu hannu da shuni kuma suna son cin abinci tare a inda suke zama a manya-manyan dakunan shakatawa domin cin abincin.
translations.reference: Another difference was that while the poor people and the woman ate their food while sitting in chairs, the rich men liked to have banquets together where they would lounge on their sides while they ate their meals.
translations.hypothesis: A striking aspect is that the poor and women consume their meals while seated on chairs, and those with disabilities also prefer to eat together in the spacious dining rooms.

translations.source: Cikin abubuwan da ake ci a tsohuwar daular Rum, ba zai kasance abincin da ya zo Turai daga Amurka ba ko kuma daga Asia a karnonin da su ka zo daga baya.
translations.reference: Ancient Roman meals couldn't have included foods that came to Europe from America or from Asia in later centuries.
translations.hypothesis: Among the foods consumed in the ancient Roman Empire, there would be no dishes that originated in the Americas or Asia, as those continents were not yet known to them.

translations.source: Alal misali, ba su da masara, babu tumatur, babu dankali. babu koko, kuma babu mutumin tsohuwar Rum da ya taɓa ɗanɗana talotalo.
translations.reference: For instance, they didn't have corn, nor tomatoes, nor potatoes, nor cocoa, and no ancient Roman ever tasted a turkey.
translations.hypothesis: For example, they have no corn, no tomatoes, no grapes, no cocoa, and no ancient Roman who has ever tasted a truffle.

translations.source: Yan Babylon sun gina wa kowanne allansu haikali da ya zama matsayin gidan allan.
translations.reference: The Babylonians built each of their gods a primary temple that was considered the home of the god.
translations.hypothesis: The Babylonians built a temple for each of their gods, which served as the god's dwelling place.

translations.source: Mutane za su kawo hadaya ga abubuwan bauta yayin da malaman bautar za su yi ƙoƙarin biyan buƙatun abubuwan bautar ta hanyar bukukuwa da shagulgula.
translations.reference: People would bring sacrifices to the gods and the priests would try to attend to the needs of the gods through ceremonies and festivals.
translations.hypothesis: People will bring offerings to the idols, while the priests of the idols will try to fulfill the idols' desires through rituals and ceremonies.

translations.source: Kowane wajen bauta tana da budaden haraba tare da kebantaccen mihrabi wanda limamai kadai ke shiga.
translations.reference: Each temple had an open temple courtyard and then an inner sanctuary that only the priests could enter.
translations.hypothesis: Each temple has a courtyard with a special altar that is only accessible to priests.

translations.source: Wasu lokuta an gina hasumiya na musamman mai siffar dala, wanda ake kira ziggurats, domin su zama sashi na haikali.
translations.reference: Sometimes special pyramid shaped towers, called ziggurats, were built to be a part of the temples.
translations.hypothesis: Sometimes, special structures shaped like pyramids, known as ziggurats, were built to serve as parts of larger buildings.

translations.source: Saman hasumiyar wuri ne na musamman na abun bautan.
translations.reference: The top of the tower was special sanctuary for the god.
translations.hypothesis: It is a unique feature of the slave trade.

translations.source: A cikin yanayi mai zafi na Gabas ta tsakiya, gida ba shi da matuƙar mahimmanci.
translations.reference: In the warm climate of the Middle East, the house was not so important.
translations.hypothesis: In the hot climate of the Middle East, having a house is not necessarily essential.

translations.source: Yawancin rayuwar dangin Ibrananci sun faru ne a sararin sama.
translations.reference: Most of the life of the Hebrew family happened in the open air.
translations.hypothesis: Most of the events in the history of the Hebrew people took place outdoors.

translations.source: Mata sun yi girki a farfajiyar; shagunan buɗe ido ne kawai suna kallon titi. An yi amfani da dutse don gina gidaje.
translations.reference: Women did the cooking in the yard; stores were just open counters looking into the street. Stone was used for building houses.
translations.hypothesis: Women were cooking outdoors; the open-air shops were simply facing the road. Houses were built using stones.

translations.source: Babu wani daji mai girma a ƙasar Kan'ana, saboda haka katako yana da tsada.
translations.reference: There were no large forests in the land of Canaan, so wood was extremely expensive.
translations.hypothesis: There are no large forests in the country, so wood is expensive.

translations.source: An zauna a Greenland a warwatse. A cikin yankin Norse sun ce an kori Erik the Red daga Iceland saboda kisan kai, kuma lokacin da ya kaɗa ya yi yamma, sai ya gano Greenland kuma ya ba ta suna Greenland.
translations.reference: Greenland was settled sparsely. In the Norse sagas they say that Erik the Red was exiled from Iceland for murder, and when travelling further west, found Greenland and named it Greenland.
translations.hypothesis: People settled in Greenland over time. In the Norse sagas, it is said that Erik the Red was exiled from Iceland for manslaughter. When he was in exile, he sailed west and discovered Greenland, which he then named.

translations.source: Amma duk da ganowar sa, dama tuni ƙabilun Eskimo suna zaune a wurin a lokacin.
translations.reference: But regardless of his discovery, Eskimo tribes were already living there at the time.
translations.hypothesis: However, it's important to remember that the Inuit people, who are often mistakenly referred to as Eskimos, have actually lived in that region for a very long time.

translations.source: Kodayake kowace ƙasa ta kasance 'Scandinavia', akwai bambance-bambance masu yawa tsakanin mutane, sarakuna, al'adu da tarihin Denmark, Sweden, Norway da Iceland.
translations.reference: Though each country was 'Scandinavian', there were many differences between the people, kings, customs and history of Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Iceland.
translations.hypothesis: While each country is considered part of Scandinavia, there are significant differences between the people, rulers, cultures, and histories of Denmark, Sweden, Norway, and Iceland.

translations.source: Idan ka kalli majigi mai suna National Treasure, za ka yi tsamanin an rubuta taswirar taska a bayan takardan Ƙudurin ‘Yancin Kai.
translations.reference: If you have watched the movie National Treasure, you may think a treasure map was written on the back of the Declaration of Independence.
translations.hypothesis: If you watch the movie "National Treasure," you might think that the Declaration of Independence was written on the back of a treasure map.

translations.source: Sai dai kuma, wannan ba gaskiya ba ne. Duk da cewa akwai wani abu da aka rubuta a bayan daftarin, ba taswirar taskar arziki ba ce.
translations.reference: However, that is not true. Although there is something written on the back of the document, it is not a treasure map.
translations.hypothesis: However, that's not true. Although there is something written on the back of the document, it is not a copy of the economic policy.

translations.source: An rubuta a bayan Bayanin Samun Ƴancin kai kalmomin “Asalin Sanarwar Samun' Yanci ne a ranar 4 ga Yuli 1776”. Rubutun ya bayyana a ƙasan takardar, juye.
translations.reference: Written on the back of the Declaration of Independence were the words "Original Declaration of Independence dated 4th July 1776". The text appears on the bottom of the document, upside down.
translations.hypothesis: The following words are written on the back of the Declaration of Independence: "The original Declaration of Independence was signed on July 4, 1776." The text is located at the bottom of the document, centered.

translations.source: A yayin da babu takamaiman wanda ya rubuta shi, an sani cewa a farkon rayuwar shi, babban takardan (yana daukar ma'aunin inci 29¾ zuwa inci 24½) an nada shi don ajiya.
translations.reference: While no one knows for certain who wrote it, it is known that early in its life, the large parchment document (it measures 29¾ inches by 24½ inches) was rolled up for storage.
translations.hypothesis: While there is no definitive record of who created it, it is known that in its early years, the large-format document (measuring approximately 29¾ inches to 24½ inches) was primarily used for storage.

translations.source: Don haka, da alama an ƙara tsarin rubutun ne kawai a matsayin laƙabi.
translations.reference: So, it is likely that the notation was added simply as a label.
translations.hypothesis: Therefore, it seems that the writing system was only added as a label.

translations.source: Saukar D-Day da yaƙe-yaƙe masu zuwa sun ƴantar da arewacin Faransa, amma har yanzu kudanci bai sami yanci ba.
translations.reference: The D-Day landings and the following battles had freed the north of France, but the south still wasn't free.
translations.hypothesis: The D-Day landings and subsequent battles liberated northern France, but the south remained under German control.

translations.source: Faransawa '' Vichy '' suka mallake shi. Waɗannan mutanen Faransa ne waɗanda suka yi sulhu da Jamusawa a 1940 kuma suka yi aiki tare da masu mamaye maimakon yaƙar su.
translations.reference: It was ruled by the "Vichy" French. These were French people who had made peace with the Germans in 1940 and worked with the invaders instead of fighting them.
translations.hypothesis: The French company "Vichy" owned it. These were French people who made peace with the Germans in 1940 and collaborated with the occupiers instead of fighting against them.

translations.source: A ranar 15 ga watan Agusta 1940, Kawayen sun mamaye kudancin Faransa, mamayar da aka yi wa lakabi da sunan “Operation Dragoon”.
translations.reference: On 15 August 1940, the Allies invaded southern France, the invasion was called "Operation Dragoon".
translations.hypothesis: On August 15, 1940, the Allies invaded Southern France in an operation codenamed "Operation Dragoon."

translations.source: A cikin makonni biyu kawai Amurkawa da Sojojin Faransa na ƴancin faransa suka ƴantar da kudancin Faransa kuma suka juya zuwa Jamus.
translations.reference: In just two weeks the Americans and Free French forces had liberated southern France and were turning towards Germany.
translations.hypothesis: In just two weeks, American and French forces of the Free French liberated southern France and then turned towards Germany.

translations.source: Wayewa al’ada ce guda wadda mutane da dama da ke zama da aiki tare na daukan nasu ce, al’umma.
translations.reference: A civilization is a singular culture shared by a significant large group of people who live and work co-operatively, a society.
translations.hypothesis: Tradition is a common practice that many people who live and work together consider to be their own culture.

translations.source: Kalmar civilization ta zo ne daga kalmar latin civilis, ma’ana farar hula, mai dangantaka da civis na Latin, ma’ana yan kasa, da cavitas, ma’ana birni ko birnin-jiha, kuma yana ba da adadin yawan jama’a.
translations.reference: The word civilization comes from the Latin civilis, meaning civil, related to the Latin civis, meaning citizen, and civitas, meaning city or city-state, and that also somehow defines the size of the society.
translations.hypothesis: The word "civilization" originates from the Latin word "civilis," which means "relating to citizens" or "refined." It is derived from "civis," meaning "citizen," and "cavitas," meaning "city" or "state," and it often implies a large population.

translations.source: Biranen gari sune kashin bayan al'ummomi. Al'adar wayewar tana nuna wucewar ilimi a cikin tsararraki da yawa, rabe-raben al'adu da rarraba gaskiya.
translations.reference: City-states are the precursors of nations. A civilizational culture implies the passing on of knowledge across several generations, a lingering cultural footprint and fair dissemination.
translations.hypothesis: Town criers are the backbone of communities. The tradition of public announcements reflects the flow of information within a society, the diversity of cultures, and the dissemination of truth.

translations.source: kananun al’adu galibi su kan shuɗe ba tare da barin tabbatattun shaidu na tarihi ba kuma ba a saka su cikin jerin manyan zamunna.
translations.reference: Minor cultures often vanish without leaving relevant historic evidence and fail to be recognized as proper civilizations.
translations.hypothesis: These traditions are often distorted or fabricated without any solid historical evidence, and they are not included in the accounts of significant historical events.

translations.source: A lokacin Yaƙin Juyin Juya Hali, jihohi goma sha ukun sun kafa gwamnatin tsakiya mai rauni - wadda ta kunshi Majalisa kawai - a ƙarƙashin dokar gwamnatin hadin gwiwa.
translations.reference: During the Revolutionary War, the thirteen states first formed a weak central government—with the Congress being its only component—under the Articles of Confederation.
translations.hypothesis: During the period of military rule, the thirty-six states established a weak central government – consisting only of a council – under the guise of a coalition government.

translations.source: Majalisa ba ta da wani iko na kakaba haraji, sannan kuma, kasancewar babu ɓangarorin zartaswa da na shari’a na ƙasar, ta dogara ne kan hukumomin jihohi, waɗanda mafi yawanci ba sa bayar da haɗin kai, wajen ganin an tilasta aiki da dokokin.
translations.reference: Congress lacked any power to impose taxes, and, because there was no national executive or judiciary, it relied on state authorities, who were often uncooperative, to enforce all its acts.
translations.hypothesis: The assembly does not have the authority to impose taxes, and furthermore, due to the absence of executive and judicial branches at the national level, it relies on state governments, which often do not cooperate, to ensure the implementation of laws and regulations.

translations.source: Hakanan ba ta da ikon yin watsi da dokokin haraji da haraji tsakanin jihohi.
translations.reference: It also had no authority to override tax laws and tariffs between states.
translations.hypothesis: It also does not have the power to waive state and local taxes.

translations.source: Labaran sun buƙaci yarjejeniya baki ɗaya daga dukkan jihohin kafin a iya gyara su kuma jihohi sun ɗauki gwamnatin tarraya a sauƙaƙe cewa wakilansu ba su nan.
translations.reference: The Articles required unanimous consent from all the states before they could be amended and states took the central government so lightly that their representatives were often absent.
translations.hypothesis: Reports indicate that a unanimous agreement from all states is required before any amendments can be made, and the states have readily accepted the government's explanation that their representatives are not currently available.

translations.source: Masu kwallon ƙafa ta ƙasar Italiya, tare da ƙungiyar ƙwallon ƙafa ta ƙasar Jamus ita ce ta biyu mafi nasara a duniya kuma sun kasance zakarun ƙwallon ƙafa na FIFA a 2006.
translations.reference: Italy's national football, along with German national football team is the second most successful team in the world and were the FIFA World Cup champions in 2006.
translations.hypothesis: Italian football, along with the German national football team, is the second most successful in the world and they were FIFA World Cup champions in 2006.

translations.source: Shahararrun wasanni sun hada da kwallon kafa, kwallon kwando, wasan kwallon raga, wasan ruwa, wasan takobi, wasan kwallon rugby, tseren kekuna, kwallon gora, wasan kwallon gorar kankara da na tseren motoci na F1.
translations.reference: Popular sports include football, basketball, volleyball, water-polo, fencing, rugby, cycling, ice hockey, roller hockey and F1 motor racing.
translations.hypothesis: Popular sports include football (soccer), basketball, volleyball, swimming, athletics (track and field), rugby, cycling, golf, and Formula 1 motor racing.

translations.source: Wasannin hunturu sun shahara a yankuna na Arewa, inda da Italiyawa su ke fafatawa a wasannin kasa da kasa da wasannin Olympic.
translations.reference: Winter sports are most popular in the Northern regions, with Italians competing in international games and Olympic events.
translations.hypothesis: Winter sports are popular in the northern regions, where Italians compete in both national and international competitions, including the Olympics.

translations.source: Japans suna riƙe da kusan tsibirai 7,000 (babba shine Honshu), yana mai sanya Japan tsibiri na 7 mafi girma a duniya!
translations.reference: Japans holds nearly 7,000 islands (the biggest being Honshu), making Japan the 7th largest island in the world!
translations.hypothesis: Japan consists of approximately 7,000 islands (the largest being Honshu), making it the 7th largest island country in the world!

translations.source: Saboda tari/rukunin tsibirai da Japan ke da su, sau da yawa akan kira Japan, a matsayin yanki, da suna “tarin tsibirai”.
translations.reference: Due to the cluster/group of islands Japan has, Japan is often referred to, on a geographical stance, as an "archipelago"
translations.hypothesis: Due to the large number of islands that Japan possesses, Japan is often referred to as an "archipelago" when discussing it as a geographical region.

translations.source: Farkon Taiwan ya faro tun baya cikin karni na 15 inda Turawa matukan jirgin ruwa da ke wucewa suka ɗauki sunan tsibirin a matsayin IIha Formosa, ko kyakyawan tsibiri.
translations.reference: Taiwan beginning start way back in 15th century where European sailors passing by record the island’s name as Ilha Formosa, or beautiful island.
translations.hypothesis: The history of Taiwan began in the early 15th century when European sailors passing through the area adopted the name "Ilha Formosa," meaning "beautiful island."

translations.source: A cikin 1624, Kamfanin Dutch East India Company ya kafa tushe a kudu maso yammacin Taiwan, yana ƙaddamar da canji a cikin ayyukan noman hatsi na asali da ɗaukar ma'aikata na China don yin aiki a gonakin shinkafa da sukari.
translations.reference: In 1624,Dutch East India Company establishes a base in southwestern Taiwan, initiating a transformation in aboriginal grain production practices and employing Chinese laborers to work on its rice and sugar plantations.
translations.hypothesis: In 1624, the Dutch East India Company established a base in southwestern Taiwan, initiating changes in the existing agricultural practices and employing Chinese laborers to work on rice and sugar plantations.

translations.source: A shekarar 1683, sojojin daular Qing (1644-1912) sun kwace ikon lardin Taiwan na yammacin da arewacin gabar teku, suka ayyana Taiwan a matsayin lardin daular Qing a shekarar 1885.
translations.reference: In 1683, Qing dynasty (1644-1912) forces take control of Taiwan’s western and northern coastal areas and declared Taiwan as a province of the Qing Empire in 1885.
translations.hypothesis: In 1683, the Qing dynasty's (1644-1912) forces conquered the western and northern coastal regions of Taiwan, and in 1885, Taiwan was formally declared a province of the Qing dynasty.

translations.source: A shekarar 1895, bayan kayarwa a cikin Farkon Yaƙin Sino-Japanese (1894-1895), gwamnatin Qing su sa-hannu a Yarjejeniyar Shimonoseki, ta wanda ta bayar da mulkin kan Taiwan zuwa ga Japan, wanda ya yi mulkin tsibirin har 1945.
translations.reference: In 1895, after defeat in the First Sino-Japanese War (1894-1895), the Qing government signs the Treaty of Shimonoseki, by which it cedes sovereignty over Taiwan to Japan, which rules the island until 1945.
translations.hypothesis: In 1895, following their victory in the First Sino-Japanese War (1894-1895), the Qing government signed the Treaty of Shimonoseki, which ceded control of Taiwan to Japan. Japan then ruled the island until 1945.

translations.source: Machu Picchu ya hada da tsari uku, masu suna Intihuatana, Temple of the Sun, da Room of the Three Windows.
translations.reference: Machu Picchu consist of three main structures, namely Intihuatana, the Temple of the Sun, and the Room of the Three Windows.
translations.hypothesis: Machu Picchu consists of three main structures: Intihuatana, the Temple of the Sun, and the Room of the Three Windows.

translations.source: An sake gina mafi yawan gine-ginen da ke gefen rukunin ginin domin ƴan yawon buɗe ido su fahimci yadda asalin siffarsu ta ke.
translations.reference: Most of the buildings on the edges of the complex have been rebuilt in order to give tourists a better idea of how they originally appeared.
translations.hypothesis: Most of the buildings along the historic district have been renovated to help visitors understand what the original structures looked like.

translations.source: Zuwa shekarar 1976, an farfado da kashi talatin na gine ginen Machu Picchu kuma har yanzu ana ci gaba da aikin.
translations.reference: By 1976, thirty percent of Machu Picchu had been restored and restoration continues till today.
translations.hypothesis: By 1976, thirty percent of the Machu Picchu ruins had been restored, and work on the project continues to this day.

translations.source: A misali, nau’in hoto marar motsi da aka fi sani a duniya shi ne 35mm, wanda shi ne girman fim na hoto da aka fi amfani da shi a ƙarshen zamanin fim ɗin hannu.
translations.reference: For example, the most common still image photography format in the world is 35mm, which was the dominant film size at the close of the analog film era.
translations.hypothesis: For example, the most common type of still photograph format worldwide is 35mm, which is the size of the photographic film that was most widely used during the heyday of film cameras.

translations.source: Har yau din nan ana sarrafa shi, amma muhimmin abu a nan kyamarar komi da ruwanka ce ta gaje shi da ke sunsuno hotuna.
translations.reference: It is still produced today, but more importantly its aspect ratio has been inherited by digital camera image sensor formats.
translations.hypothesis: This camera is still being managed, but the most important thing here is the image sensor and processing unit, which are responsible for capturing and processing the images.

translations.source: Abin mamaki shine zubin 35mm a haƙiƙa fadin 36mm ya ke da shi da kuma tsawon 24mm.
translations.reference: The 35mm format is actually, somewhat confusingly, 36mm in width by 24mm in height.
translations.hypothesis: Interestingly, the 35mm lens actually has a diameter of 36mm and a length of 24mm.

translations.source: A lissafin wannan tsarin (idan aka raba sha biyu domin samun adadi mafi karancin lamba) zai kasance a daidaiton 3:2.
translations.reference: The aspect ratio of this format (dividing by twelve to obtain the simplest whole-number ratio) is therefore said to be 3:2.
translations.hypothesis: In this system, if we divide by two to obtain the smallest possible number, the ratio will be 3:2.

translations.source: Yawancin hanyoyin gama gari na yau da kullun (misali tsarin APS na iyali) ya kusa da wannan tsari.
translations.reference: Many common formats (APS family of formats, for example) are equal to or closely approximate this aspect ratio.
translations.hypothesis: Most common and conventional methods (such as the family APS system) are similar to this approach.

translations.source: Dokar da aka fi rainawa itace dokar gina dynamism tare da tabbatar da tsarin a hoto.
translations.reference: The much-abused and often-ridiculed rule of thirds is a simple guideline creating dynamism while keeping a measure of order in an image.
translations.hypothesis: The most important principle is to build dynamism while ensuring a coherent structure.

translations.source: Ya bayyana cewa wuri mafi mahimmanci a darasin shine mahadar layuka wanda ya raba hoton a tsaye da kuma a kwance (duba misali).
translations.reference: It states that the most effective place for the main subject is at the intersection of lines dividing the image into thirds vertically and horizontally (see example).
translations.hypothesis: He explained that the most important element in the diagram is the axis, which divides the image vertically and horizontally (see example).

translations.source: A wannan lokaci na tarihin Tarayyan Turai, cocin Katolika, wadda ta yi ƙarfi da arziki, ta fuskanci bincike.
translations.reference: During this period of European history, the Catholic Church, which had become rich and powerful, came under scrutiny.
translations.hypothesis: During this period in European history, the powerful and wealthy Catholic Church faced scrutiny.

translations.source: Sama da shekara dubu addinin Kirista ya haɗe kasashen Turai waje guda duk da banbance banbance na harsuna da ala’adu.
translations.reference: For over a thousand years the Christian religion had bound European states together despite differences in language and customs. I
translations.hypothesis: For over a thousand years, Christianity has united the countries of Europe, despite their differences in language and culture.

translations.source: Ƙarfin barnansa ta shafe kowa daga sarki har na gama-gari.
translations.reference: Its all-pervading power affected everyone from king to commoner.
translations.hypothesis: The impact of his actions affected everyone, from the king to the common people.

translations.source: Daya daga cikin shishikan addinin krista shine yin amfani da arziki wajen magance matsaloli da kuma yakar talauci sannan kuma jami’in kudi na cocin suna can musamman saboda wannan dalilin.
translations.reference: One of the main Christian tenets is that wealth should be used to alleviate suffering and poverty and that the monetary funds of the church are there specifically for that reason.
translations.hypothesis: One of the core tenets of Christianity is the use of wealth to address problems and combat poverty, and church treasurers are particularly focused on this principle.

translations.source: Babban cibiyar shugabancin coci ta kasance a Roma sama da dubban shekaru kuma mayar da arziki da mulki can ya jawo cece-kuce game da ko ana bin wannan shikashikin.
translations.reference: The central authority of the church had been in Rome for over a thousand years and this concentration of power and money led many to question whether this tenet was being met.
translations.hypothesis: The central leadership of the church has been based in Rome for over a thousand years, and this concentration of power and authority has sparked debate about whether this structure is appropriate.

translations.source: Jim kaɗan bayan ɓarkewar tashin hankalin, Birtaniya ta fara toshe mashigan ruwa na Jamus.
translations.reference: Soon after the outbreak of hostilities, Britain initiated a naval blockade of Germany.
translations.hypothesis: Shortly after the outbreak of the conflict, Britain began to blockade German ports.

translations.source: Dabarun sun yi tasiri, hana shigar da muhimman kayayyakin soja da na farar hulla, ko da yake wannan toshewa ta sabawa dokoki na ƙasa da ƙasa waɗanda yarjejeniyoyin ƙasa da ƙasa da dama na ƙarnoni biyu da suka wuce suka tsara.
translations.reference: The strategy proved effective, cutting off vital military and civilian supplies, although this blockade violated generally accepted international law codified by several international agreements of the past two centuries.
translations.hypothesis: The sanctions have been effective in preventing the import of critical military and mining equipment, although this blockade violates international laws established by numerous international agreements over the past two centuries.

translations.source: Birtaniya ta dasa bama bamai a teku domin hana jiragen ruwa shiga wannan yanki na teku, abinda ke da hadari ga jiragen yan baruwanmu.
translations.reference: Britain mined international waters to prevent any ships from entering entire sections of ocean, causing danger to even neutral ships.
translations.hypothesis: Britain has deployed mines in the sea to prevent ships from entering this area, which poses a danger to our fishing vessels.

translations.source: Tunda aka samu karancin sakamako ga wannan dabarun, Jamus tayi tsammanin sakamako irin haka zuwa ga yakin kasan tekun da bashi da kayyadewa.
translations.reference: Since there was limited response to this tactic, Germany expected a similar response to its unrestricted submarine warfare.
translations.hypothesis: Since this strategy yielded disappointing results, Germany anticipated similar outcomes in the unrestricted submarine warfare campaign.

translations.source: A lokacin 1920s, halaye mafi rinjaye na yawancin ƴan ƙasa da ƙasashe shine na zaman lafiya da keɓewa.
translations.reference: During the 1920s, the prevailing attitudes of most citizens and nations was that of pacifism and isolation.
translations.hypothesis: During the 1920s, the prevailing attitudes of many nations and people were those of peace and isolation.

translations.source: Bayan ganin munanan abubuwa da munanan yaƙe-yaƙe yayin Yaƙin Duniya na ɗaya, al'ummomi sun so su guje wa irin wannan yanayin a nan gaba.
translations.reference: After seeing the horrors and atrocities of war during World War I, nations desired to avoid such a situation again in the future.
translations.hypothesis: After witnessing the horrors and devastation of the First World War, societies sought to avoid such a situation in the future.

translations.source: A cikin 1884, Tesla ya koma Amurka don karɓar aiki tare da Kamfanin Edison a cikin New York City.
translations.reference: In 1884, Tesla moved to the United States of America to accept a job with the Edison Company in New York City.
translations.hypothesis: In 1884, Tesla moved to America to work for the Edison Company in New York City.

translations.source: Ya iso Amurka da sulai 4 kacal, da wani littafin wakoki, da wasikar gabatarwa daga Charles Batchelor (manajansa a aikin da ya bari) zuwa ga Thomas Edison.
translations.reference: He arrived in the US with 4 cents to his name, a book of poetry, and a letter of recommendation from Charles Batchelor (his manager in his previous job) to Thomas Edison.
translations.hypothesis: He arrived in America with just $4 in his pocket, a songbook, and a letter of introduction from Charles Batchelor (his former manager) to Thomas Edison.

translations.source: Ƙasar China ta zamanin da tana da wata hanyar musamman ta nuna lokutan yanayi daban-daban; kowane mataki na China ko kowane iyali da ya hau karagar mulki to shi ma daula ce ta daban.
translations.reference: Ancient China had a unique way of showing different time periods; each stage of China or each family that was in power was a distinctive dynasty.
translations.hypothesis: China is a country with a unique way of marking different periods; each dynasty or ruling family represents a distinct era.

translations.source: Haka nan tsakanin kowace daula a kan sami lokaci na rashin zaman lafiya tsakanin larduna. Fitacce daga waɗannan zamuna shi ne zamanin Masarautu Uku da ya faru tsawon shekaru 60 tsakanin Daular Han da ta Jin.
translations.reference: Also between each dynasty was an unstable age of divided provinces. The best-known of these periods was the Three Kingdoms epoch taking place for 60 years between the Han and the Jin Dynasty.
