translations.hypothesis: The capital of Moldova is Chișinău. The official language is Romanian, but Russian is also widely spoken.

translations.source: Maldova jamhuriya ce mai kabilu da dama da ta yi fama da rikicin kabilanci.
translations.reference: Moldova is a multi-ethnic republic that has suffered from ethnic conflict.
translations.hypothesis: Moldova is a multi-ethnic republic that has experienced ethnic conflict.

translations.source: A shekarar 1994, wannan rikici ya haifar da kirkirar da kanta mai ikirarin Jamhuriyyar Transnistria a gabashin Moldova, wacce ke da gwamnatinta da kudin ta amma ba wata kungiyar mambobin Majalisar Dinkin Duniya ta amince da shi ba.
translations.reference: In 1994, this conflict led to the creation of the self-proclaimed Transnistria Republic in eastern Moldova, which has its own government and currency but is not recognised by any UN member country.
translations.hypothesis: In 1994, this conflict led to the creation of the self-proclaimed Transnistria Republic in eastern Moldova, which has its own government and currency, but is not recognized by any member state of the United Nations.

translations.source: An maido da harkar cinikayya tsakanin bangarori biyu na Maldova duk da rushewar tattaunawar siyasa.
translations.reference: Economic links have been re-established between these two parts of Moldova despite the failure in political negotiations.
translations.hypothesis: Trade relations between the two regions of Moldova have been restored despite the breakdown of political negotiations.

translations.source: Babban addini a Moldova shine Kiristocin aqidah.
translations.reference: The major religion in Moldova is Orthodox Christian.
translations.hypothesis: The dominant religion in Moldova is Christianity.

translations.source: Izmir shi ne birni na uku mafi girma a Turkiyya da yawan jama’a kimanin miliyan 3.7, kuma tashar jiragen ruwa ta biyu mafi girma bayan ta Istanbul, kuma babbar cibiyar sufuri.
translations.reference: İzmir is the third largest city in Turkey with a population of around 3.7 million, the second biggest port after Istanbul, and a very good transport hub.
translations.hypothesis: Izmir is the third-largest city in Turkey, with a population of approximately 3.7 million, and the second-largest port after Istanbul, making it a major transportation hub.

translations.source: A da yana a matsayin tsohon birnin Smyrna, yanzu cibiyar hada-hadar kasuwanci ce ta zamani, da ta bnƙasa, da ta ke zagayen wani ƙaton mashigin ruwa sannan kuma yana zagaye da duwatsu.
translations.reference: Once the ancient city of Smyrna, it is now a modern, developed, and busy commercial center, set around a huge bay and surrounded by mountains.
translations.hypothesis: It was once the ancient city of Smyrna, now a modern commercial center, built on a narrow isthmus surrounded by a small bay and hills.

translations.source: Manya-manyan tituna, gidajen gilashi da manyan kantunan siyayya an kawata su da jajayen rufi na gargajiya, kasuwa ta karni na 18, da wani tsohon masallaci da coci, koda yake dai garin ya fi kama da irin na turai da ke gabar bahar rum fiye da ace garin gargajiya ne a kasar Turkiya.
translations.reference: The broad boulevards, glass-fronted buildings and modern shopping centers are dotted with traditional red-tiled roofs, the 18th century market, and old mosques and churches, although the city has an atmosphere more of Mediterranean Europe than traditional Turkey.
translations.hypothesis: The main streets, glass houses, and large shopping centers are lined with traditional blue roofs, creating a 18th-century market atmosphere. There's also an old mosque and church, although the town feels more like a European resort on the Black Sea coast than a traditional Turkish town.

translations.source: Kauyen Haldarsvík yana ba da damar kallon tsibirin Eysturoy da ke kusa kuma yana da wata cocin mai kusurwa takwas wadda ba saba ganin irin ta ba.
translations.reference: The village of Haldarsvík offer views of the nearby island Eysturoy and has an unusual octagonal church.
translations.hypothesis: The village of Haldarsvík offers views of the nearby island of Eysturoy and features a unique octagonal church, which is quite rare.

translations.source: A cikin farfajiyar majami'ar, akwai zane-zanen marmara mai ban sha'awa na kurciya akan wasu kaburburan.
translations.reference: In the churchyard, there are interesting marble sculptures of doves over some tombs.
translations.hypothesis: Inside the museum, there are fascinating marble sculptures depicting various scenes on some of the tombs.

translations.source: Shafe rabin sa’a na tattaki a cikin shu’umin ƙauyen ya biya.
translations.reference: It's worth half an hour to stroll about the intriguing village.
translations.hypothesis: Spending half an hour walking through the village's greenery was worth it.

translations.source: Ta gefen arewa mai saukin shiga nan ne Birnin Sintra ya ke wanda ya shahara ga yan kasashen waje bayan da Lord Byron ya bada kayatattun labaran kyawonta.
translations.reference: To the north and within easy reach is the romantic and fascinating town of Sintra and which was made famous to foreigners after a glowing account of its splendours recorded by Lord Byron.
translations.hypothesis: Located on the easily accessible northern slope is the city of Sintra, which became famous among foreign visitors after Lord Byron praised its beauty.

translations.source: Scotturb Bus 403 na yin tafiya sosai zuwa Sintra, tare da dakatawa a Cabo da Roca.
translations.reference: Scotturb Bus 403 travels regularly to Sintra, stopping at Cabo da Roca.
translations.hypothesis: The Scotturb Bus 403 makes frequent trips to Sintra, with stops in Cabo da Roca.

translations.source: Hakanan zuwa arewa ziyarci babban Wuri Mai Tsarki na Uwargidanmu Fatima (Shrine), wuri ne na shahararrun bayyanar Marian a duniya.
translations.reference: Also to the north visit the great Sanctuary of Our Lady of Fatima (Shrine), a place of worldwide famous Marian apparitions.
translations.hypothesis: Also, when traveling north, be sure to visit the magnificent Shrine of Our Lady of Fatima, a place renowned for its significant Marian apparitions worldwide.

translations.source: Da fatan za a tuna cewa da gaske ana ziyartar babban kabari ne, kazalika da shafin da ke da kusan ma'ana ga yawancin ɓangarorin duniya.
translations.reference: Please remember that you are essentially visiting a mass grave site, as well as a site that has an almost incalculable meaning to a significant portion of the world's population.
translations.hypothesis: Please note that this is a significant historical site, and also a place that holds meaning for many people around the world.

translations.source: Har yanzu akwai maza da mata da yawa da ke raye waɗanda suka rayu lokacinsu a nan, kuma da yawa da yawa waɗanda suke da ƙaunatattunsu waɗanda aka kashe ko suka yi aiki zuwa can, yahudawa da waɗanda ba Yahudawa ba.
translations.reference: There are still many men and women alive who survived their time here, and many more who had loved ones who were murdered or worked to death there, Jews and non-Jews alike.
translations.hypothesis: Even now, there are many men and women who are survivors, who lived through that time, and many more who have loved ones who were killed or who emigrated to other places, both Jewish and non-Jewish.

translations.source: Da fatan za a kula da rukunin yanar gizon tare da dukkan mutunci, girmamawa da girmama shi. Kada ku yi ba'a game da fitinar Holocaust ko Nazis.
translations.reference: Please treat the site with all of the dignity, solemnity and respect it deserves. Do not make jokes about the Holocaust or Nazis.
translations.hypothesis: Please treat this website with respect, dignity, and consideration. Do not engage in any offensive or disrespectful behavior, especially regarding the Holocaust or Nazis.

translations.source: Kada ku lalata wurin ginin ta hanyar sa alamar ko kuma nuna alamar rubutu a cikin ginin.
translations.reference: Do not deface the site by marking or scratching graffiti into structures.
translations.hypothesis: Please do not damage the building by placing any signs or writing on it.

translations.source: Harsunan Barcelona na yau da kullun sune Catalan da Spanish. Kimanin rabin sun fi son yin magana da Catalan, yawancinsu sun fahimce shi, kuma kusan kowa ya san Sifen.
translations.reference: Barcelona's official languages are Catalan and Spanish. About a half prefer to speak Catalan, a vast majority understands it, and virtually everyone knows Spanish.
translations.hypothesis: The most commonly spoken languages in Barcelona are Catalan and Spanish. Approximately half of the population prefers to speak Catalan, many understand it, and almost everyone knows some Spanish.

translations.source: Ko da yake, ana nuna galibin alamomin ana nuna su Katalanci sakamakon bisa doka shi ne yaren hukumana farko.
translations.reference: However, most signs are indicated only in Catalan because it is established by law as the first official language.
translations.hypothesis: While the majority of signs display Catalan, the official language is, by law, the first language used.

translations.source: Duk da haka, ana kuma amfani da harshen Spanish sosai a harkar sufuri na jama’a da wasu wurare.
translations.reference: Yet, Spanish is also widely used in public transport and other facilities.
translations.hypothesis: However, the Spanish language is also widely used in the public transportation sector and in certain other areas.

translations.source: Ana yin sanarwar yau da gobe a jirgin ƙarƙashin ƙasa a Catalan kaɗai, amma na’urar da ke aiki da kanta ce ke sanar da hargitsin da babu shiri a harsuna iri-iri da suka haɗa da Sifaniyanci, Turanci, Faransanci, Larabci da harshen Japan.
translations.reference: Regular announcements in the Metro are made only in Catalan, but unplanned disruptions are announced by an automated system in a wide variety of languages including Spanish, English, French, Arabic and Japanese.
translations.hypothesis: Today and tomorrow, announcements on the Barcelona metro system will only be available in Catalan. However, the device itself provides information about service disruptions in a variety of languages, including Spanish, English, French, Arabic, and Japanese.

translations.source: Mutanen Paris sun yi suna kan son kai, rashin kunya da girman kai.
translations.reference: Parisians have a reputation for being egocentric, rude and arrogant.
translations.hypothesis: People of Paris are known for their arrogance, lack of shame, and pride.

translations.source: Yayin da yake wannan yawanci ra’ayi ne wanda ba daidai ba, hanya mafi kyau don yin sabo a cikin Paris har yanzu shine kasancewa kan halayyarka mafi kyau, yin aiki kamar wanda yake “bien élevé” (wanda ya sami tarbiyya mai kyau). Zai sanya yin sabo ya kasance mai sauki.
translations.reference: While this is often only an inaccurate stereotype, the best way to get along in Paris still is to be on your best behavior, acting like someone who is "bien élevé" (well brought up). It will make getting about considerably easier.
translations.hypothesis: While this is often a misconception, the best way to navigate Paris and make a good impression is still to be yourself, but to act in a way that is considered "well-mannered" or "refined." This will make your experience much smoother.

translations.source: Fuskar mutanen Paris ta bazata za ta yi saurin ɓacewa idan ka nuna wasu halayen girmamawa.
translations.reference: Parisians' abrupt exteriors will rapidly evaporate if you display some basic courtesies.
translations.hypothesis: The people of Paris are generally polite, but they might quickly become offended if you display certain disrespectful behaviors.

translations.source: Tafkunan Plitvice na wajen shakatawa yana da wani surkukin daji, galibi da kamannin bishiyoyin fir da na kudan zuma da kuma hadin wanda ya shafi manyan tsaunuka da duwatsu tare da ciyaye na Rum.
translations.reference: The Plitvice Lakes national park is heavily forested, mainly with beech, spruce, and fir trees, and features a mixture of Alpine and Mediterranean vegetation.
translations.hypothesis: The Plitvice Lakes recreation area features a dense forest, typically with coniferous and deciduous trees, and a landscape characterized by towering mountains and rocky terrain, interspersed with Roman ruins.

translations.source: Tana da sanannun dangogin itatuwa iri daban-daban, sabo da jerin yankunan yanayi da ta ke da su, da bayyana nau’ukan ƙasa daban-daban da kuma tuddai masu mataki daban-daban.
translations.reference: It has a notably wide variety of plant communities, due to its range of microclimates, differing soils and varying levels of altitude.
translations.hypothesis: It boasts a diverse range of plant species, owing to its varied climatic zones, different soil types, and varying elevations.

translations.source: Rukunin muhalli na ga dabbobin daji mabambanta da kuma launukan tsuntsaye.
translations.reference: The area is also home to an extremely wide variety of animal and bird species.
translations.hypothesis: The environmental organization focuses on protecting diverse wildlife and bird species.

translations.source: Dabbobin daji da ba su da yawa irin su Malu mai launin ruwan kasa da ke turai, kerkeci, mikiya, mujiya, kyanwar daji da kuma capercaillie a na iya samun su a can, tare da nau’ukan gama garin dabbobi masu yawa.
translations.reference: Rare fauna such as the European brown bear, wolf, eagle, owl, lynx, wild cat and capercaillie can be found there, along with many more common species
translations.hypothesis: The region is home to a variety of wildlife, including rare species such as the brown bear, lynx, wild boar, deer, forest grouse, and capercaillie, as well as a diverse range of other animals.

translations.source: Yayin ziyartar gidajen sufaye, an buƙaci mata su sa riguna masu rufe gwiwowinsu kuma su rufe ƙafadunsu, kuma.
translations.reference: While visiting the monasteries, women are required to wear skirts covering the knees and have their shoulders covered, too.
translations.hypothesis: During visits to religious sites, women were asked to wear clothing that covered their arms and legs.

translations.source: Mafi yawancin gidajen ibada suna samar da mayafai ga matan da ba su zo da shiri ba, amma idan ki ka zo da naki, musamman wanda yake da launuka masu haske, za ki sami murmushi daga mai bauta namiji ko mace a ƙofar shiga.
translations.reference: Most of the monasteries do provide wraps for women who come unprepared, but if you bring your own, especially one with bright colors, you'll get a smile from the monk or nun at the entrance.
translations.hypothesis: Most places of worship provide scarves for women who haven't brought their own, but if you bring your own, especially one with bright colors, you might get a smile from a male or female attendant at the entrance.

translations.source: A bisa wannan madogara, ana buƙatar maza su sanya wanduna da ke rufe gwiwoyi.
translations.reference: Along the same line, men are required to wear trousers covering the knees.
translations.hypothesis: According to this regulation, men are required to wear trousers that cover their knees.

translations.source: Wannan ma za a iya aro shi daga tarin kayan a mashigar amma ba a wanke tufa bayan kowane mutum guda ya yi amfani da tufar don haka ba za ka/ki ji dadin saka wannan bujen ba. Kala guda zai iyamma dukkanin maza.
translations.reference: This too can be borrowed from the stock at the entrance but that clothing isn't washed after every user so you may not feel comfortable wearing these skirts. One size fits all for men!
translations.hypothesis: This item can also be rented from the equipment rental counter, but the towels are not washed after each use, so you might not be comfortable using them. One size will fit all men.

translations.source: Babban abincin, kamar na yankuna masu kama da wannan a cikin Bahar Rum, ya dogara ne akan burodi, kayan lambu da nama (musamman alade), kuma yana amfani da man zaitun ko'ina.
translations.reference: Majorcan cuisine, like that of similar zones in the Mediterranean, is based on bread, vegetables and meat (specially pork), and uses olive oil throughout.
translations.hypothesis: The main dishes, similar to those found in regions with a similar climate in the Mediterranean, rely on bread, vegetables, and meat (especially lamb), and olive oil is used extensively.

translations.source: Abincin dare mai sauki musamman ma lokacin bazara, shi ne na Pa amb Oli: Burodi ne da man zaitun da tumatir da kuma duk wani kayan hadin da ya samu kamar cukwui da abincin kifi da dai sauransu.
translations.reference: A simple popular dinner, especially during the summer, is the Pa amb Oli: Bread with olive oil, tomato, and any available condiments such as cheese, tunafish, etc.
translations.hypothesis: A simple dinner, especially popular in the summer, is Pa amb Oli: it's bread with olive oil, tomatoes, and any other ingredients you like, such as sugar, fish, and so on.

translations.source: Dukkan sunaye, wadanda ke da kalmar Sie a ciki, koda yaushe suna farawa ne da babban harafi, koda a tsakiyar jimla ne.
translations.reference: All nouns, alongside the word Sie for you, always begin with a capital letter, even in the middle of a sentence.
translations.hypothesis: All names containing the word "Sie" (which is a formal German pronoun) must always be capitalized, regardless of where they appear in a sentence.

translations.source: Wannan mahimmiyar hanya ce wajen banbance kalmomin aikatau da kalmomi na abubuwa da ake iya gani.
translations.reference: This is an important way to distinguish between some verbs and objects.
translations.hypothesis: This is an important way to distinguish between action words (verbs) and words that describe things (nouns).

translations.source: Hakanan yana iya kawo sauƙin karatu, kodayake rubutu yana da ɗan rikitarwa ta hanyar buƙatar gano ko ana amfani da fi'ili ko sifa a cikin sigar tabbatarwa.
translations.reference: It also arguably makes reading easier, though writing is somewhat complicated by the need to find out whether a verb or adjective is used in a substantivized form.
translations.hypothesis: It can also facilitate learning, although the writing system can be somewhat complex due to the need to determine whether a verb or adjective is being used in the affirmative form.

translations.source: Furuci yana da ɗan sauƙi a cikin Italiyanci tunda yawancin kalmomi ana furta daidai yadda ake rubuta suu
translations.reference: Pronunciation is relatively easy in Italian since most words are pronounced exactly how they are written
translations.hypothesis: Italian is relatively easy to learn because many words are pronounced exactly as they are written.

translations.source: Manyan haruffan da ya kamata a lura da su a nan sune c da g, kasancewar furucinsu ya banbamta daga wannan wasalin da ke biye.
translations.reference: The main letters to watch out for are c and g, since their pronunciation varies based on the following vowel.
translations.hypothesis: The main letters to pay attention to here are 'c' and 'g', as their pronunciations differ from what follows.

translations.source: Hakanan, tabbatar da furta r da rr daban: caro yana nufin ƙaunata, yayin da karas yana nufin karusa.
translations.reference: Also, make sure to pronounce r and rr differently: caro means dear, whereas carro means chariot.
translations.hypothesis: Also, be sure to distinguish between the sounds "r" and "rr": "caro" means "my love," while "karas" means "increase."

translations.source: Farisa tana da nahawu mai sauki da na yau da kullum.
translations.reference: Persian has a relatively easy and mostly regular grammar.
translations.hypothesis: France has a simple and everyday charm.

translations.source: Saboda haka, karanta wannan share fagen nahawun zai taimaka muku koya da yawa game da nahawun Farisanci da fahimtar jumla da kyau.
translations.reference: Therefore, reading this grammar primer would help you learn much about Persian grammar and understand phrases better.
translations.hypothesis: Therefore, reading this grammar lesson will help you learn a lot about French grammar and improve your understanding of sentences.

translations.source: A bayyane take, idan ka san yaren Romance, zai yi sauki maka ka koyi Portuguese.
translations.reference: Needless to say, if you know a Romance language, it will be easier for you to learn Portuguese.
translations.hypothesis: It's clear that if you know a Romance language, you'll find it easier to learn Portuguese.

translations.source: Duk da haka, mutanen da ba su iya yaren sifaniyanci sosai ba ke ganin yaren Portuguese ya yi kusa da shi yadda ba lallai a karance shi daban ba.
translations.reference: However, people who know a little Spanish may hastily conclude that Portuguese is close enough that it need not be studied separately.
translations.hypothesis: However, people who are not very familiar with the Romance languages often find that the Portuguese language is close enough to them that it doesn't necessarily need to be learned separately.

translations.source: Yawanci hasumiyoyin nazarin samaniya na baya sun zama tsohon yayi yanzu, inda suka zama gidajen kayan tarihi, ko kuma wuraren koyon ilimi.
translations.reference: Pre-modern observatories are usually obsolete today, and remain as museums, or sites of education.
translations.hypothesis: Many of the historical astronomical observatories of the past have now become outdated, and have been repurposed as museums or educational centers.

translations.source: Kamar yadda gurbacewar haske a lokacin ganiyasa ba kamar irin yadda matsalar take a halin yanzu ba, galibi ya fi yawa a birane da kuma harabobin makarantun jami’a, wanda ya fi saukin samuwa akan wadanda aka gina a birane.
translations.reference: As light pollution in their heyday was not the kind of problem it is today, they are usually located in cities or at campuses, easier to reach than those built in modern times.
translations.hypothesis: Unlike the current situation where light pollution is a widespread problem, it was historically more prevalent in cities and around university campuses, and was more easily noticeable in areas built within those urban environments.

translations.source: Yawancin gilasan hangen nesa na bincike na zamani kayayyaki ne masu girma sosai a yankunan da ke da tsarin yanayi masu kyau.
translations.reference: Most modern research telescopes are enormous facilities in remote areas with favorable atmospheric conditions.
translations.hypothesis: Most modern research telescopes are very large instruments and are typically located in regions with favorable atmospheric conditions.

translations.source: Kallon buɗewar furen cherry, wanda aka sani da hanami, ya kasance wani ɓangare na al'adun Japan tun ƙarni na 8.
translations.reference: Cherry blossom viewing, known as hanami, has been a part of Japanese culture since the 8th century.
translations.hypothesis: The practice of viewing cherry blossoms, known as "hanami," has been a part of Japanese culture since the 8th century.

translations.source: Tunanin ya fito ne daga China inda plum da suka yi girma sun kasance fure ne wanda aka fi so.
translations.reference: The concept came from China where plum blossoms were the flower of choice.
translations.hypothesis: The idea originated in China, where plums that had grown large were considered a delicacy.

translations.source: A Japan, sarkin ne ya shirya kungiyar siyasa na farko don kan sa kawai da wasu membobin da ke da martaba kewaye da kotun sarakuna..
translations.reference: In Japan, the first cherry blossom parties were hosted by the emperor only for himself and other members of the aristocracy around the Imperial Court.
translations.hypothesis: In Japan, the emperor established the first political organization, consisting solely of himself and a select group of influential members of the imperial court.

translations.source: Tsirrai sun fi kyau idan suna muhallinsu na halitta, saboda haka guji zumuɗin tsige ko da samfur “daya ne kawai”.
translations.reference: Plants look their best when in a natural environment, so resist the temptation to remove even "just one" specimen.
translations.hypothesis: Plants thrive best when they are in their natural environment, so avoid transplanting them, even if it's just "one."

translations.source: Idan kana ziyartar shiryayen lambu, tattara “samfurori” shi ma zai iya jawo wa a fitar da kai, ba tare da tattaunawa ba.
translations.reference: If visiting a formally arranged garden, collecting "specimens" is also going to get you ejected, without discussion.
translations.hypothesis: If you are visiting agricultural exhibitions, collecting "samples" without permission can also lead to legal trouble.

translations.source: Garin Singapore gari ne da akasari ya ke da tsaro ingantacce kuma da saukin ganewa, kuma ka na iya siyen komai daga saukarka a kasar.
translations.reference: Singapore is generally an extremely safe place to be and very easy to navigate, and you can buy almost anything after arriving.
translations.hypothesis: Singapore is a city known for its high levels of safety and cleanliness, and you can find everything from local products to international brands there.

translations.source: Amma ana sanya ku a cikin “manyan yankuna masu tsaka-tsakin” kawai ƴan digiri kaɗan arewacin kerjin za ku buƙaci ma'amala da zafin rana (koyaushe) da rana mai ƙarfi (lokacin da sama ta bayyana, mafi wuya).
translations.reference: But being placed in the "high tropics" just a few degrees north of equator you will need to deal with both heat (always) and strong sun (when the sky is clear, more rarely).
translations.hypothesis: However, even in the "temperate zones," just a few degrees north of the equator, you'll need to deal with intense sunshine (almost constantly) and strong sunlight (especially when the sky is clear, which is often the case).

translations.source: Akwai kuma motocin bas kaɗan masu tafiya arewa zuwa Hebron, asalin wurin da aka binne shugabanni da aka ambata a baibul Ibrahim, Isa, Yakub, da matansu.
translations.reference: There are also a few buses going north to Hebron, the traditional burial place of the Biblical patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and their wives.
translations.hypothesis: There are also a few buses that travel north to Hebron, the original site where the biblical figures Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, along with their wives, are believed to be buried.

translations.source: Ka tabbatar motar da zaka shiga lalle wadda za ta je Hebron ce ba wadanda ke zuwa sabbin unguwanni yahudawa da ke Kiryat Arba ba ne.
translations.reference: Check that the bus you are thinking of taking goes into Hebron and not just to the nearby Jewish settlement of Kiryat Arba.
translations.hypothesis: Please make sure the car you get into is definitely the one going to Hebron, and not the ones that are going to the new Jewish settlements in Kiryat Arba.

translations.source: Jirgin ruwa na cikin gida na iya zama jigo mai kyau don kafa hutu a kusa.
translations.reference: Inland waterways can be a good theme to base a holiday around.
translations.hypothesis: A swimming pool can be a great centerpiece for creating a relaxing atmosphere.

translations.source: A misali ziyartar fadoji a Loire Valley, kwarin Rhine ko hawan jirgin ruwa zuwa wurare masu ban sha’awa a Danube ko tafiya cikin kwalekwale ta Erie Canal.
translations.reference: For example visiting castles in the Loire Valley, the Rhine valley or taking a cruise to interesting cites on the Danube or boating along the Erie Canal.
translations.hypothesis: For example, you could visit vineyards in the Loire Valley, explore the Rhine River, take a boat trip to interesting places on the Danube, or travel by canal boat through the Erie Canal.

translations.source: Hakanan suna ayyana hanyoyi don shahararrun tattaki da hanyoyin keke.
translations.reference: They also define routes for popular hiking and cycling trails.
translations.hypothesis: They also provide routes for popular hiking trails and cycling paths.

translations.source: Kirsimeti wani biki ne mai mahimmanci na Kiristanci, kuma ana bikinta a matsayin ranar haihuwar Yesu.
translations.reference: Christmas is one of the most important holidays of Christianity, and is celebrated as the birthday of Jesus.
translations.hypothesis: Christmas is a significant Christian holiday, and it is celebrated as the day of Jesus' birth.

translations.source: Da yawan an al’adun da ke zgaye da bikin sun sami karɓuwa har daga waɗanda ba su yi imani ba a kasashen kristoci da waɗanda bana kristoci ba a fadin duniya.
translations.reference: Many of the traditions surrounding the holiday have been adopted also by non-believers in Christian countries and non-Christians around the world.
translations.hypothesis: Many of the traditions associated with the festival have been embraced, even by those who do not share the same beliefs, both in Christian countries and in non-Christian countries around the world.

translations.source: Akwai wata al'ada ta kwanan zaune a daren Easter a wani wuri buɗaɗɗe don ganin fitowar rana.
translations.reference: There's a tradition to pass the Easter night awake at some exposed point to see the sunrise.
translations.hypothesis: There is a tradition of staying up late on Easter night in some places, often outdoors, to watch the sunrise.

translations.source: Tabbas da akwai bayanai daga koyarwar addinin Kirista kan wannan al’adar, amma dai yana iya kasancewa Shekaru ne gabanin bayyanar Kiristanci.
translations.reference: There are of course Christian theological explanations for this tradition, but it may well be a pre-Christian Spring and Fertility ritual.
translations.hypothesis: Certainly, there is information from Christian teachings about this tradition, but it may have existed for many years before the advent of Christianity.

translations.source: Churchesarin majami'u na gargajiya sau da yawa suna yin Vigil na Easter a daren Asabar a lokacin karshen mako na Ista, tare da ikilisiyoyin galibi suna shiga cikin murna a tsakar dare don bikin tashin Almasihu.
translations.reference: More traditional churches often hold an Easter Vigil on Saturday night during the Easter weekend, with the congregations often breaking into celebration at the stroke of midnight to celebrate Christ's resurrection.
translations.hypothesis: Traditional churches often hold Easter vigils on Holy Saturday evening during the Easter weekend, with congregations typically gathering for a celebratory service late into the night to commemorate the resurrection of Christ.

translations.source: Duk dabbobin da suka isa tsibirin asalin sun zo nan ne ta hanyar iyo, tashi ko iyo.
translations.reference: All animals that originally arrived in the islands came here either by swimming, flying or floating.
translations.hypothesis: All the animals that arrived on the island came there by swimming, flying, or floating.

translations.source: Saboda doguwar nesa daga nahiyoyi masu shayarwa ba su iya yin tafiyar ba wanda ya sa katowar kunkuru matsayin dabba ta farko da ake kiwo a Galapagos.
translations.reference: Due to the long distance from the continent mammals were unable to make the journey making the giant tortoise the primary grazing animal in the Galapagos.
translations.hypothesis: Due to the long distance from mainland areas, they were unable to migrate, which is why the Galapagos tortoise became the first animal to be domesticated in the Galapagos Islands.

translations.source: Tun zuwan mutum ga Galapagos, an gabatar da dabbobi masu shayarwa da yawa da suka hada da awaki, dawakai, shanu, beraye, kuliyoyi da karnuka.
translations.reference: Since the arrival of man to the Galapagos, many mammals have been introduced including goats, horses, cows, rats, cats and dogs.
translations.hypothesis: Since humans arrived in the Galapagos, numerous introduced species have been brought to the islands, including pigs, donkeys, cattle, goats, cats, and dogs.

translations.source: Idan ka ziyarci nahiyar Arctic ko Antarctica a lokacin hunturu zaka tsinkayi daren sanyi, wanda a lokacinsa rana bata fitowa.
translations.reference: If you visit the Arctic or Antarctic areas in the winter you will experience the polar night, which means that the sun doesn't rise above the horizon.
translations.hypothesis: If you visit the Arctic or Antarctic regions during the winter, you will experience long, cold nights where the sun does not rise.

translations.source: Wannan yana ba da kyakkyawar dama don ganin Aurora borealis, tunda sama zata kasance mai duhu sosai ko ƙasa da agogo.
translations.reference: This offers a good opportunity to see the Aurora borealis, as the sky will be dark more or less around the clock.
translations.hypothesis: This provides a great opportunity to see the Aurora Borealis, as the sky will be very dark, or even completely dark, after midnight.

translations.source: Tunda yankunan ba su da cinkoson jama’a, kuma babu matsalar gurɓacewar haske, za kuma ka ji daɗin taurarin.
translations.reference: As the areas are sparsely populated, and light pollution therefore often not a problem, you will also be able to enjoy the stars.
translations.hypothesis: Since these areas are sparsely populated and have little light pollution, you can also enjoy the stars.

translations.source: Al’adun aiki na Japanese na da matsayi fiye da abin da kasashen yamma suka saba.
translations.reference: Japanese work culture is more hierarchical and formal that what Westerners may be used to.
translations.hypothesis: Japanese work culture places a higher value on certain aspects than is typical in Western countries.

translations.source: Kwat sune kayan sawa na aiki da aka saba dasu kuma abokan aiki suna kiran juna ne da sunan gidan su ko kuma matsayin da mutum yake kai.
translations.reference: Suits are standard business attire, and coworkers call each other by their family names or by job titles.
translations.hypothesis: Uniforms are standard work attire, and colleagues often address each other by the name of their company or the position they hold.

translations.source: Zaman lafiya a wurin aiki abu ne me muhimmanci, ana bada mahimmanci wurin hadaka tare sama da jinjina yin aiki kai daya.
translations.reference: Workplace harmony is crucial, emphasizing group effort rather than praising individual accomplishments.
translations.hypothesis: A harmonious work environment is crucial, and it involves fostering collaboration and promoting teamwork.

translations.source: Dole ne ma’aikata su sami amincewar manyan su akan duk wata shawara da suka zartas, kuma ana tsammanin su yi biyayya ga umarnin manyan su ba tare da tambaya ba.
translations.reference: Workers must often get their superiors' approval for any decisions they make, and are expected to obey their superiors' instructions without question.
translations.hypothesis: Employees are required to obtain approval from their superiors for any decisions they make, and they are expected to follow the instructions of their superiors without question.
